notes: đầy hy vọng, tràn trề hy vọng

blocks.title: Có nhiều anh chị em

items.en: I have two brothers and two sisters. It is always crowded in my house. We used to fight all the time when we were little. But I like having many siblings now. It’s fun to spend time together with them.

blocks.title: Mặc lại quần áo của chị gái

items.en: I have an older sister. When I was a kid, I wore my sister’s hand-me-downs all the time. As I grew up, I became taller than my sister. It felt good to wear new clothes.
notes: đồ cũ được truyền lại (quần áo)
trở nên cao hơn ai đó

blocks.title: Đại gia đình sum họp vào dịp lễ Tết

items.en: I have a big family and many cousins. On holidays, we all gather at my house. Last Christmas, we had dinner together. After dinner, we went bowling. It was fun. We had a wonderful time.

blocks.title: Đã làm trụ cột gia đình

chunks: and I had two part-time jobs
items.en: My father passed away when I was young. Since then, I have been the breadwinner in my family. I had a part-time job after school, and I had two part-time jobs on weekends. I felt exhausted every day.

blocks.title: Em trai nghiện game

items.en: My brother is always in his room playing computer games. He eats and sleeps in his room. So I barely see him in the house. He is totally addicted to computer games.

blocks.title: Khi cần thư giãn thì chơi game là nhất

items.en: Playing games helps me release stress. When I am overwhelmed by life and have too many things to think about, I just play games for a few minutes. It helps me forget about things. I feel better after playing games.

blocks.title: Chơi game thức trắng đêm

items.en: Yesterday, I bought a new computer game. It’s called The Hunter. I started to play it and couldn’t stop. I ended up staying up all night playing the game.
notes: cuối cùng lại làm gì đó

blocks.title: Chỉ chơi game miễn phí

chunks: I just had to buy all of them.
items.en: I used to spend a lot of money on games. New games kept coming out and I just had to buy all of them. However, I can’t afford to buy all the games that I want to play anymore. I only play free online games now.
notes: không đủ khả năng để làm gì

blocks.title: Đã tiêu tiền mua vật phẩm trong game

chunks: this nice sword and a suit
items.en: When I play online games, it is very easy to spend money on in-game items. For example, I really wanted to have this nice sword and a suit for my game character, so I spent 30,000 won in just one minute.

blocks.title: Đã thắng ván cá cược bữa trưa

chunks: My friend and I are into this new game
items.en: My friend and I are into this new game called Candy Crush. We played it at Starbucks today. It was really fun playing with my friend and I even won a lunch on a bet. I felt great.

items.en: It was very crowded in the amusement park. I waited in line for an hour to go on a single ride. The ride was 30 seconds long. It was so frustrating to wait in such a long line.

blocks.title: Diễu hành thú vị hơn trò chơi

items.en: I prefer watching parades to going on rides. The amusement park is close to my house. It takes 30 minutes by bus. Sometimes I go there only to watch the parades. They make me laugh.

items.en: I don’t like haunted houses because I don’t want people in masks touching me. However, my little brother loves to be scared. He tortures himself with horror movies all the time.

blocks.title: Bị stress vì nhịn ăn để giảm cân

items.en: I wanted to lose weight. However, I didn’t want to exercise. I decided not to eat. I lost weight by skipping meals. I didn’t eat anything. I felt stressed because I was too hungry.

items.en: I didn’t eat for a week. I lost weight but a week later, when I started to eat again, I gained even more weight. It’s called the yo-yo effect. I decided to go to the gym to exercise. I lost weight and never gained it back.
notes: hiệu ứng yo-yo (giảm cân rồi tăng trở lại)

items.en: I lost 5 kg by eating onions. I ate an onion before dinner and I only had small portions of food. Sometimes I just skipped dinner. It was hard to eat onions, but it worked. I also exercised three times a week.

items.en: My friend lost 10 kg in just one month. She said she ate small portions of food. She also exercised regularly. I tried to go to the gym after work. It was hard. I ended up just going to the park to take a walk.

items.en: I decided to go on a diet, so I went jogging every day. I went to the park in the neighborhood to jog. However, I couldn’t give up eating late at night. I had late-night snacks quite often. I failed to lose weight.

blocks.title: Đọc sách giúp trí tưởng tượng phong phú hơn

because I can forget about things.
items.en: I read two to three books a month. It takes time to read a book. I like reading because I can forget about things. I also think I become more imaginative from reading books.

blocks.title: Vừa đọc vừa gạch chân trong sách

chunks: I sometimes write down some notes
items.en: I like reading books. It calms me down. When I read, I underline the important passages. It is helpful to read. I sometimes write down some notes on the book when I think it is important.

blocks.title: Viết cảm nhận sau khi đọc xong sách

chunks: I always write a book report
items.en: When I finish a book, I always write a book report on it. It helps to organize my thoughts. Last weekend, I read an interesting novel. After that, I spent two hours writing a book report on it.

blocks.title: Thường giữ sách sạch sẽ khi đọc

I try to take good care of the books.
That’ts why I don’t like lending my books
when a friend returns the book
items.en: I like to keep my books clean. I try to take good care of the books. When I read, I never write on or fold the pages. That’s why I don’t like lending my books to friends. It bothers me when a friend returns the book with folded pages.

blocks.title: Đọc sách giúp nảy ra ý tưởng

chunks: I used to read a lot.
because when I read a book,
items.en: I used to read a lot. Recently, I have been reading less than before. I try to read more because when I read a book, great ideas come to me. I prefer reading to watching TV when I need to think.

blocks.title: Đọc đi đọc lại nhiều lần với sách khó

chunks: When I read a difficult book,
I need to reread the same sentences
items.en: I read books to get useful information. However, sometimes it is hard to understand certain books. When I read a difficult book, I need to reread the same sentences over and over to completely understand the paragraph.

blocks.title: Khá an toàn vì có nhiều camera giám sát

chunks: my mom always yells at me
items.en: It is safe to live in my neighborhood. There are many surveillance cameras in the area, so I feel safe to get around late at night. However, my mom always yells at me when I come home late. I want to live alone.

blocks.title: Giao thông thuận tiện

chunks: The subway station is just a few blocks away
items.en: There is a bus stop in front of my house. The subway station is just a few blocks away from my house, so it is convenient to use public transportation. I always travel by public transportation.

to get to know your neighbors.
items.en: I live in an apartment but I don’t get along with my neighbors. I actually don’t even know who lives next door. But I think it is important to get to know your neighbors.

blocks.title: Gần đây khu phố xảy ra nhiều vụ trộm cướp

so I try to go home
So when no one is home,
items.en: I usually come home late at night. However, there have been a lot of robberies in the neighborhood recently, so I try to go home early in the evening. But it is scary to be home alone. So when no one is home, I get together with friends.

blocks.title: Hàng xóm thân thiết còn hơn cả anh em

items.en: I am very close to some of my neighbors. We see each other almost every day. I think they are closer to me than my siblings are. I like spending time with my neighbors.

blocks.title: Cũng có khi cãi nhau vì chuyện đỗ xe

items.en: There are not enough parking spaces in my neighborhood. It is difficult to find a spot when you try to park late at night. It is frustrating. Some neighbors often argue over parking.
notes: cãi nhau vì điều gì đó

I first went into a hot tub
items.en: I like scrubbing my body at the public bath. I went to the public bath yesterday. I first went into a hot tub and sat for 30 minutes and then started scrubbing. After scrubbing for 20 minutes, I felt like I had lost 1 kg.

blocks.title: Đeo chìa khóa ở cổ tay

chunks: The first time I went to a public bath,
I left my locker key somewhere
to find the spare key to my locker.
I always wear a locker key
items.en: The first time I went to a public bath, I left my locker key somewhere and I had to wait for the owner to find the spare key to my locker. Since then, I always wear a locker key around my wrist while bathing.

blocks.title: Kỳ lưng cho nhau càng thân hơn với bạn

like we became closer to each other.
items.en: I went to a public bath with a friend for the first time not long ago. He asked me to scrub his back. After scrubbing his back, he washed my back. By washing each other’s back, I felt like we became closer to each other.

blocks.title: Cởi hết quần áo rồi cân nặng

and put them in a locker.
items.en: I am on a diet. I weighed 50 kg a week ago. I checked my weight again in the public bath today, and I still weighed 50 kg. I took all my clothes off and put them in a locker. I weighed myself again. I weighed 49 kg. I felt better.

blocks.title: Ở trong phòng xông hơi 5 phút rồi ra

is to turn an hourglass over.
I just wanted to stay in
So when half of it ran out,
items.en: When I go into a hot sauna, the first thing I do is to turn an hourglass over. I just wanted to stay in for 5 minutes but it was a 10- minute hourglass. So when half of it ran out, I turned it over and left the sauna.

blocks.title: Nhờ nhân viên kỳ lưng kỳ cọ

and recently I started to ask someone else

for scrubbing and a brief massage.
items.en: I used to scrub my body myself. My mom always asks the person who works there to scrub her. I couldn’t understand at first, but as I got older, I understood her and recently I started to ask someone else to scrub me. She is so good at it. I usually pay her 20,000 won for scrubbing and a brief massage.

for more than half an hour.
that the last bus had left

blocks.title: Đông người nên lên bằng cửa sau

but most of them were all blurry.
I am such a bad photographer.
items.en: I went to my favorite singer’s concert. I took a lot of pictures of her but most of them were all blurry. I am such a bad photographer.

blocks.title: Không lên hình đẹp

items.en: My friend looks so pretty in pictures. She is so photogenic. On the other hand, I’m not very photogenic. It is sad. However, I don’t think she is prettier than me at all. She is just photogenic.

blocks.title: Thích đi nhà sách

chunks: even though there is nothing in particular
items.en: I like going to bookstores. It is fun looking around a bookstore. When I have time, I just go there and pick up some books even though there is nothing in particular I want to buy.

blocks.title: Không tìm thấy cuốn sách cần tìm

chunks: The book I was looking for
to see if they have a copy.
items.en: The book I was looking for was not in stock at the bookstore I went to. So I called another bookstore to see if they have a copy. They did, so I went there and got it.

blocks.title: Mua nhiều hơn dự định

chunks: I had a list of books
I ended up buying more books
items.en: I had a list of books that I needed. I went to a bookstore with my list and got all excited. I ended up buying more books than I needed.
notes: cuối cùng lại làm gì đó

blocks.title: Có kệ trưng bày sách bán chạy riêng

chunks: When I go to a bookstore,
I first go straight to the bestseller section.
items.en: When I go to a bookstore, I first go straight to the bestseller section. There are shelves for bestsellers only. It is always fun to see the books on the shelves.

blocks.title: Từng mua nhầm sách lỗi nên luôn kiểm tra kỹ

chunks: I once got a new book
I had to go back to the bookstore
items.en: I once got a new book at the bookstore but it was damaged. I had to go back to the bookstore the next day. Since then, I always check before buying a book.

blocks.title: Tìm sách bằng máy tra cứu sách

chunks: because I don’t have to chase bookstore staff
items.en: There are kiosks for searching for books at the bookstore. It is convenient to use them because I don’t have to chase bookstore staff to ask for help.
notes: quầy, ki-ốt thông tin tự động

blocks.title: Nhờ nhân viên nhà sách tìm giúp sách

chunks: I was having a hard time
the book was out of stock.
so I asked the bookstore staff
items.en: I was having a hard time finding a book. I looked it up on the kiosk, but it said the book was out of stock. I really needed the book so I asked the bookstore staff for help and he helped me to locate it. He was so nice.

blocks.title: Bạn gái đi mua sắm quá lâu

items.en: I don’t like going shopping with my girlfriend. When we go shopping, it takes forever. She usually spends five hours on shopping. She tries on everything. It makes me feel stressed.

blocks.title: Ăn thử nhiều món ở siêu thị

chunks: I went to the grocery store
items.en: I like trying samples at a food market. I usually go grocery shopping when I am hungry. Yesterday, I went to the grocery store and tried too many samples as always. I was too full to have dinner afterwards.

blocks.title: Kiểm tra hạn sử dụng khi đi chợ

chunks: I usually check the expiration dates
I don’t have to worry about throwing away food.
items.en: When I go grocery shopping, I usually check the expiration dates before buying anything. It only takes 2 seconds to check. That way, I don’t have to worry about throwing away food.

blocks.title: Bỏ đi mà không mua gì vì nhân viên bán hàng

chunks: and walked out of the store.
items.en: I walked into a store and the sales clerk asked if I needed any help. I said no and walked around. She followed me. It was annoying. I couldn’t stand it and walked out of the store.

blocks.title: Không đổi trả được vì không có hóa đơn

chunks: If I am not happy with my purchase,
I tried to return an item
But I could only exchange it
items.en: If I am not happy with my purchase, I can return it. However, I must have the receipt. I tried to return an item without a receipt. But I could only exchange it for another item.

blocks.title: Thích mua sắm ở quầy hàng vỉa hè

chunks: I can get a cash discount.
I don’t want to spend much money
items.en: It is nice to shop at street stalls. I can get a cash discount. I always pay in cash when shopping at street stalls. I like getting a discount. I don’t want to spend much money on shopping.
notes: giảm giá khi trả tiền mặt

blocks.title: Hóa đơn cước phí ra rất nhiều

chunks: I like to watch YouTube video clips
items.en: I like to watch YouTube video clips on my phone. I used too much data for the Internet last month on my phone and I ended up receiving an enormous bill this month.

blocks.title: Đã làm mất điện thoại

chunks: I went to the lost andfound,
I went to buy a new phone,
but since I didn’t have the old one,
I couldn’t transfer all my contact numbers.
items.en: I lost my phone on the subway. I went to the lost and found, but couldn’t find it. I went to buy a new phone, but since I didn’t have the old one, I couldn’t transfer all my contact numbers.

blocks.title: Nhờ tài xế taxi mà tìm lại được điện thoại

chunks: and the driver picked it up.
I gave him the cab fare
items.en: I left my phone in a cab. I called my phone and the driver picked it up. He came to where I was with the meter on. I gave him the cab fare plus 30,000 won for finding it.

blocks.title: Hay nhắn tin nên gọi điện thấy ngại

chunks: I am so used to it
items.en: I often send text messages to my friends. It is easy to use and more importantly, it is free to use. I am so used to it that I rarely make calls. It even feels awkward to talk on the phone.

blocks.title: Mang theo sạc pin bên mình

chunks: So I always carry a charger around
because I use my smartphone very often
and the battery dies so quickly.
items.en: I do so many things with my phone. I listen to music and play games on my phone. So I always carry a charger around because I use my smartphone very often and the battery dies so quickly.

blocks.title: Tắt điện thoại trong giờ học

chunks: I turned it off right away,
I always turn my phone off
items.en: My phone rang in the middle of class. I turned it off right away, but the professor asked whose phone it was. I stood up and I was so embarrassed. Since then, I always turn my phone off during class.

blocks.title: Ghét ăn cơm một mình

chunks: When I was taking classes by myself online,
items.en: I don’t like eating alone. When I have no one to eat with, I just skip the meal and have some bread instead. When I was taking classes by myself online, I lost 5 kg in one semester.

blocks.title: Ăn cơm phải im lặng, không gây tiếng động!

chunks: and one of the people at my table
items.en: I was at lunch and one of the people at my table was eating with his mouth open. His noisy eating bothered me. Furthermore, while he was talking, some food spattered onto mine. I couldn’t eat anymore.

blocks.title: Mua món ăn kèm về ăn

chunks: I used to make side dishes myself.
on my way home from work.
items.en: I used to make side dishes myself. However, I don’t have time to cook anymore. So I just buy some at the grocery store on my way home from work. They taste pretty good.

blocks.title: Giờ đã dùng đũa thành thạo

chunks: I was bad at using chopsticks.
but my dad always told me
that I should be able to use chopsticks well.
and now I am pretty good at using them.
items.en: When I was young, I was bad at using chopsticks. My mom gave me a fork to use instead but my dad always told me that I should be able to use chopsticks well. I tried hard and now I am pretty good at using them.

blocks.title: Vươn vai trước mâm cơm là không được!

chunks: to stretch in front of the table.
items.en: I was having lunch with my professor and classmates the other day. I didn’t get enough sleep the night before, so I was tired. I stretched, but then the professor said it was rude to stretch in front of the table. I didn’t know. I was embarrassed.

blocks.title: 10 giờ tối là giờ ăn khuya của bố

chunks: My dad comes home from work
He always eats snacks with beer
I think he should go out and exercise
instead of eating snacks at night.
items.en: My dad comes home from work at 7. He eats dinner right away and then watches TV. His habit is eating snacks at 10 p.m. He always eats snacks with beer and he has gained 5 kg in a month. I think he should go out and exercise instead of eating snacks at night.

blocks.title: Không hẹn được vì lịch không khớp

chunks: My friend and I were planning
but we couldn’t make any plans
that works for both of us.
items.en: My friend and I were planning to have dinner together but we couldn’t make any plans because it was hard to set a time that works for both of us. I think she is too busy.

blocks.title: Hủy hẹn vì không khỏe

chunks: the pork I had last night
I had to cancel on my friend
items.en: I didn’t feel good all day. I think the pork I had last night had gone bad. It was seasoned with sauce so I couldn’t really tell. I had to cancel on my friend and go home and rest. I felt bad.

blocks.title: Lo lắng vì hai cuộc hẹn trùng nhau

chunks: to let any of my friends down.
items.en: I have accidentally double-booked myself for Friday dinner. I don’t want to let any of my friends down. I really don’t know what to do.
notes: đặt hai lịch hẹn trùng nhau

blocks.title: Người bạn luôn trễ hẹn

chunks: I like to be on time,
but my friend Kim is always late.
So I told her to meet me
items.en: I like to be on time, but my friend Kim is always late. It is annoying. So I told her to meet me at 7 p.m. today and I showed up at 7:30. It worked. She showed up at 7:20. I will always do this from now on.

blocks.title: Luôn ghi chú lại các cuộc hẹn

chunks: I started to use the memo function
I can also set an alarm
items.en: I always write down plans that I’ve made because I easily forget things. I started to use the memo function on my smartphone and it is very convenient. I can also set an alarm for my plans.

blocks.title: Cho bạn leo cây vì quên mất cuộc hẹn

chunks: I totally forgot about my dinner plans
even though I didn’t mean to.
I felt so sorry for her.
items.en: I totally forgot about my dinner plans with a friend. My phone was dead and I stood her up even though I didn’t mean to. I felt so sorry for her. I called her after I got home and she sounded really mad. I am scared.
notes: điện thoại của tôi bị hết pin, tắt máy
cảm thấy áy náy với ai đó

blocks.title: Xóa nhầm email quan trọng vì tưởng là thư rác

chunks: I have received so many spam mails
from loan services and adult websites.
I once accidentally deleted an important email
items.en: Recently, I have received so many spam mails from loan services and adult websites. It is so annoying. I once accidentally deleted an important email from my boss because I thought it was spam.

blocks.title: Quên đính kèm tập tin

chunks: and had to send it again.
items.en: My boss told me to send him the itinerary for our business trip. I emailed him without attaching the itinerary file. I got yelled at and had to send it again. I felt so stupid.

blocks.title: Mất nhiều thời gian để đính kèm tập tin dung lượng lớn

chunks: to send her the Power Point slides
that I used for my presentation.
items.en: My friend asked me to send her the Power Point slides that I used for my presentation. It took so long to attach this large file. I think it almost took 30 minutes.

blocks.title: Có hai tài khoản email cho mục đích khác nhau

chunks: and the other one is Hotmail.
My Gmail account is for everything
including getting coupons and announcements for events.
to keep in touch with my friends.
items.en: I have two different accounts from two different websites. One is Gmail and the other one is Hotmail. My Gmail account is for everything including getting coupons and announcements for events. I use the Hotmail account to keep in touch with my friends.
notes: giữ liên lạc với ai đó

blocks.title: Đã quên mất ID và mật khẩu

chunks: I had a job interview yesterday
I forgot my ID and password,
so I can’t check my email now.
items.en: I had a job interview yesterday and they told me to check my email today to see the result. I forgot my ID and password, so I can’t check my email now. I feel so stupid. I don’t know what to do.

blocks.title: Email dài đã bị mất trắng

chunks: The email was about 3 pages long
When I turned my computer back on,
items.en: I wrote a long email to my old friend. We haven’t talked for almost 10 years so I had so much to tell her. The email was about 3 pages long but suddenly the power went out. I literally freaked. When I turned my computer back on, it was all gone.

blocks.title: Người đàn ông bất lịch sự nhìn thấy ở sân ga

chunks: a man rushed and tried to get on the train
before the passengers on the train got off.
items.en: I was waiting in line to get on the subway. Everyone was waiting behind the white line on the platform. When the subway arrived, a man rushed and tried to get on the train before the passengers on the train got off. He was so rude.

blocks.title: Đã chuyển tàu ở ga trung chuyển

chunks: When I went to visit my friend,
but I had to transfer to line 3.
I went to the transfer station,
items.en: When I went to visit my friend, I first took subway line 2, but I had to transfer to line 3. I went to the transfer station, which was about 5 stops away, and transferred to subway line 3. It was easy.

blocks.title: Đã lên nhầm tàu ngược chiều

chunks: On the first day of work,
but I got on the one
and I ended up being late.
items.en: On the first day of work, I remember being so nervous. I took the subway but I got on the one going in the opposite direction. I realized it about three stops later and I ended up being late.

blocks.title: Tìm lại túi bị mất ở trung tâm đồ thất lạc

chunks: I left my bag in the subway
that I had left one of them behind.
I called the lost and found department right away
but they didn’t have it yet.
and I went there to get it.
items.en: I left my bag in the subway this morning. I had two bags and I realized that I had left one of them behind. I called the lost and found department right away but they didn’t have it yet. When I called them again, they had it and I went there to get it.

blocks.title: Ngủ gật nên đi quá ga cần xuống

chunks: and I ended up missing my stop.
and was really late for school.
items.en: I stayed up so late last night. I was very tired on my way to school. I was dozing off on the subway and I ended up missing my stop. I woke up three stops later and was really late for school.

blocks.title: Không xuống được tàu điện ngầm

chunks: I got on a packed train.
I usually take the bus to work
but I woke up late today
so I had to take the subway.
There were so many people on the train
that I couldn’t get off at my stop.
items.en: This morning, I got on a packed train. I usually take the bus to work but I woke up late today so I had to take the subway. There were so many people on the train that I couldn’t get off at my stop. I was so upset.

blocks.title: Luôn gọi món theo combo

chunks: I always order a combo meal.
When I get just a cheeseburger,
if I order a combo meal,
items.en: When I go to McDonald’s, I always order a combo meal. When I get just a cheeseburger, it costs 3,500 won. However, if I order a combo meal, it costs 5,000 won for a cheeseburger, a Coke, and French fries.

blocks.title: Nhân viên nhắc lại đơn hàng qua micro

chunks: so that the kitchen staff can hear the order.
and I wanted to try doing that job
items.en: When I order my food, the worker repeats it into the microphone so that the kitchen staff can hear the order. I remember that when I was young, it was interesting to see and I wanted to try doing that job one day.

blocks.title: Được châm thêm coca miễn phí

chunks: My friend and I went to Burger King.
so we ordered two burgers and one Coke.
They give free soft drink refills
so we decided to share one Coke.
items.en: My friend and I went to Burger King. We only had 6,000 won so we ordered two burgers and one Coke. They give free soft drink refills so we decided to share one Coke.
notes: châm thêm nước ngọt miễn phí

blocks.title: Trễ 5 phút nên lỡ mất món giảm giá

chunks: the lunch menu was not available
items.en: Wendy’s have their lunch menu from 11:00 a.m. to 2 p.m. They offer the lunch menu at 50% off. I went there for lunch yesterday but it was 5 minutes past 2. They said the lunch menu was not available at that time. I was very disappointed.
notes: có sẵn, có thể dùng được

blocks.title: Đồ ăn nhanh dọn dẹp sau khi ăn rất tiện

chunks: When I don’t feel like cooking,
I pick up some food there,
about eating fast food at home
I can just put the trash in a bag
items.en: When I don’t feel like cooking, I just go out to the fast food restaurant in front of my house. I pick up some food there, come home and eat. The good thing about eating fast food at home is that it is easy to clean up. I can just put the trash in a bag and throw it away.

blocks.title: Đã chia sẻ bánh Big Mac với bạn

chunks: so we ordered one Big Mac.
We cut it into four pieces
and I was only going to eat one piece.
that we ended up eating two pieces each
items.en: When I went to McDonald’s with my friend the other day, I was on a diet so we ordered one Big Mac. We cut it into four pieces and I was only going to eat one piece. It was so good that we ended up eating two pieces each and finished the burger.

blocks.title: Lập cafe và trở thành quản trị viên

chunks: and I wanted to share information
so I decided to make an online bike club
and become the manager of it.
items.en: I love biking and I wanted to share information on different bicycles with other bikers. I looked up online to find a bike club, but couldn’t find one. I have good computer skills, so I decided to make an online bike club and become the manager of it.

blocks.title: Quyết định rời khỏi cafe vì không khí quá căng thẳng

chunks: I once joined an online discussion club.
Members discussed a lot of different topics
how people could get so aggressive.
and decided to drop out of the club.
items.en: I once joined an online discussion club. Members discussed a lot of different topics and it seemed interesting. When I joined the discussion for the first time, I was surprised to see how people could get so aggressive. I felt very uncomfortable and decided to drop out of the club.

blocks.title: Đăng câu hỏi lên cafe và có 10 người trả lời

chunks: I recently joined an online book club.
and share our feelings and thoughts
items.en: I recently joined an online book club. We read a book once a week and share our feelings and thoughts about it. It is so much fun. I posted some questions about this week’s book and 10 members responded.

blocks.title: Cafe bóng đá của em trai có hơn 100 nghìn thành viên

chunks: My brother joined an online soccer community.
that more than one hundred thousand members
about their favorite teams and players
items.en: My brother joined an online soccer community. He told me that more than one hundred thousand members have joined this community. They put up new information about their favorite teams and players and share video clips with other members.

blocks.title: Cafe đang tổ chức sự kiện giảm giá

chunks: There is a brand-new ESL academy
If you join their online community
to sign up for the class,
items.en: There is a brand-new ESL academy that just opened near Gangnam station. They are holding an event to offer a discount when signing up for class. If you join their online community and bring one friend to sign up for the class, they give you a 10% discount on your tuition fee.
notes: tiếng Anh như ngôn ngữ thứ hai

blocks.title: Cuối cùng bỏ cuộc vì thủ tục gia nhập cafe quá phức tạp

chunks: I heard about this discount event
that a brand-new ESL academy is having.
I decided to join the online community
When I tried to sign up,
items.en: I heard about this discount event that a brand-new ESL academy is having. I decided to join the online community to get a discount. When I tried to sign up, there were so many steps to follow and it was confusing. I tried it twice and then gave up.

blocks.title: Phải đăng bài 10 lần mới được nâng cấp thành viên

chunks: When I first joined an online book club,
I could only see 3 category posts
In order to see the rest of them,
my member status needed to be upgraded.
items.en: When I first joined the online book club, I could only see 3 category posts out of 10. In order to see the rest of them, my member status needed to be upgraded. I had to write 10 posts to be upgraded.

blocks.title: Thành viên độc đoán đã bị đuổi khỏi nhóm

chunks: There was a member of the online discussion club
He not only had strong opinions,
but when some people didn’t agree with his opinion
he even cursed at those people.
kicking him out of the club.
items.en: There was a member of the online discussion club who constantly raised his voice during the discussion. He not only had strong opinions, but when some people didn’t agree with his opinion he even cursed at those people. The club manager ended up kicking him out of the club.
notes: có ý kiến mạnh mẽ, cứng rắn
đuổi ai đó ra khỏi đâu đó

blocks.title: Bán bánh kẹo, đồ uống, đồ vệ sinh cá nhân, văn phòng phẩm, thực phẩm ăn liền

chunks: I hardly buy toiletries and stationery there
items.en: I like looking around at convenience stores. They mainly sell snacks, beverages, toiletries, stationery, and instant food. I hardly buy toiletries and stationery there because they are more expensive than ordinary stores.
notes: đồ dùng vệ sinh cá nhân

blocks.title: Đi cửa hàng tiện lợi mua nước suối

chunks: So my mom always tells me
to boil the tap water first
but I recently started to drink bottled water.
items.en: It is not safe to drink the tap water in my area. So my mom always tells me to boil the tap water first and then drink it. I used to boil it, but I recently started to drink bottled water. I just buy the bottles from the convenience store on my way back home. My mom is thinking of getting a water purifier at home.

blocks.title: Cửa hàng tiện lợi tuy đắt nhưng vẫn thông cảm được

chunks: Convenience stores usually charge higher prices
than ordinary grocery stores or supermarkets.
it is because they don’t buy as many products
There is a big grocery store
right in front of my house,
so I rarely go to a convenience store.
items.en: Convenience stores usually charge higher prices than ordinary grocery stores or supermarkets. I guess it is because they don’t buy as many products as large chain supermarkets. There is a big grocery store right in front of my house, so I rarely go to a convenience store.
notes: cửa hàng tạp hóa thông thường

blocks.title: Dịch vụ chuyển phát của cửa hàng tiện lợi rẻ và tiện

chunks: I haven’t used the service yet,
it was cheaper and more convenient
than a regular post office service.
items.en: Convenience stores have recently started a courier service. They charge you 5,000 won per package. I haven’t used the service yet, but my friend said it was cheaper and more convenient than a regular post office service.

blocks.title: Có quá nhiều cửa hàng tiện lợi

chunks: There are way too many convenience stores
that there are many of them
but we only have one bookstore
items.en: There are way too many convenience stores in the city. You can find one on almost every corner. It is certainly convenient that there are many of them around, but we only have one bookstore in my neighborhood. I think that is a problem.
notes: ở hầu như mọi góc phố

blocks.title: Cửa hàng tiện lợi thường có máy rút tiền

chunks: Convenience stores usually have an ATM machine.
I almost never use the ATM
because they charge you a 1,000 won fee
items.en: Convenience stores usually have an ATM machine. I almost never use the ATM in the convenience store because they charge you a 1,000 won fee when withdrawing money, which is insane. I always make sure I carry enough cash with me.

blocks.title: Uống bia ở bàn trước cửa hàng tiện lợi

chunks: When the weather is nice outside,
I usually go to a convenience store
items.en: When the weather is nice outside, I usually go to a convenience store in front of my house and have some beers there. They have a few tables outside the store, so I usually sit there and have beers and snacks with my friends.

blocks.title: Hay mua cơm nắm và mì ly ở cửa hàng tiện lợi

chunks: I don’t like to cook for just myself
so I usually go to a convenience store
I often buy Korean rice balls
They might not be good for my health
items.en: I live alone. I don’t like to cook for just myself so I usually go to a convenience store on my way home. I often buy Korean rice balls and instant cup noodles. They might not be good for my health but they certainly taste good.

blocks.title: Mùa xuân khổ sở vì dị ứng phấn hoa

chunks: I was doing a presentation in class
and my nose was running like water.
items.en: I am allergic to pollen. I have a runny nose and itchy eyes in the spring. It bothers me so much. Yesterday, I was doing a presentation in class and my nose was running like water. I was so embarrassed. I can’t stand spring.
notes: bị dị ứng với cái gì đó

blocks.title: Mùa hè khổ sở vì rôm sảy

chunks: I sweat a lot in summer
and I suffer from heat rash.
because it makes my skin itchy.
My friends used to make fun of me
items.en: I sweat a lot in summer and I suffer from heat rash. I don’t like it because it makes my skin itchy. It’s frustrating. My friends used to make fun of me when I was young. I prefer winter to summer.
notes: chịu đựng, khổ sở vì điều gì đó
thích cái này hơn cái kia

blocks.title: Mùa đông vất vả dọn tuyết

chunks: When I was in the army,
I had to shovel up the snow
items.en: When I was in the army, I had to shovel up the snow in winter. It worried me whenever it started to snow. I remember one time I shoveled up the snow all day long. I was exhausted.

blocks.title: Mùa đông rất sợ lạnh

chunks: I hated wearing a school uniform
to keep warm and look cool
items.en: I feel the cold more than others. I hated wearing a school uniform in the winter because it is hard to keep warm and look cool at the same time. Someone told me I needed to exercise regularly. Since then, I work out at the gym every morning.

blocks.title: Mùa thu đi ngắm lá đỏ

chunks: I often go to the mountain
and look at the beautiful leaves
I haven’t been to the mountain
so I am planning on going
items.en: My favorite season is fall because I like enjoying the fall leaves. There is a small mountain behind my house. I often go to the mountain with my friends or family and look at the beautiful leaves in the fall. I haven’t been to the mountain this year yet so I am planning on going next week.

blocks.title: Có vẻ mùa xuân và mùa thu ngày càng ngắn lại

chunks: like there are only two seasons:
items.en: Spring and fall are tending to get shorter. Yesterday, the weather was beautiful. It finally felt like winter was over and spring had arrived. However, today, it is 86 degrees outside. It feels like there are only two seasons: summer and winter.

blocks.title: Mùa hè ngày dài, thích hợp hoạt động ngoài trời

chunks: like the summer daytime has been
items.en: Summer has a longer daytime than winter, but recently it feels like the summer daytime has been much longer than before. I like it because I enjoy outdoor activities. For example, I play soccer every other day. On the weekends, I play baseball after breakfast. I feel good after playing sports.

blocks.title: Mùa hè mất ngủ vì muỗi

items.en: I hate mosquitoes. I get easily bitten by them. I couldn’t sleep last night because of mosquitoes. I was stressed. I got out of bed and watched TV until 3 in the morning. I am so tired today.

blocks.title: Mùa đông luôn thoa kem dưỡng da

chunks: Even though I don’t have much time
and I literally had no time
to put any moisturizing lotion on my face.
I had to bring the moisturizing lotion with me
items.en: My skin gets very dry in winter. Even though I don’t have much time in the morning, I never forget to put on moisturizing lotion. However, I slept in today, and I literally had no time to put any moisturizing lotion on my face. I had to bring the moisturizing lotion with me and apply it on the bus. It was a bit embarrassing, but I had no choice.

blocks.title: Đi dạo trong công viên

chunks: It refreshes my mind and body.
I love having a cup of coffee
it is my favorite time of the day.
items.en: I usually take a walk in the park on weekends. It refreshes my mind and body. I love having a cup of coffee at the park after dinner. I think it is my favorite time of the day.

blocks.title: Không uống nước ở vòi công cộng trong công viên

items.en: I jog in the park every morning. After jogging, I get very thirsty, but I never drink from water fountains. I worry about getting sick from the water. So I just wait until I get home.

blocks.title: Đã dành thời gian cùng gia đình ở công viên

items.en: A week ago, I went to the park with my family. We sat on the grass with a mat. We listened to music on my phone. My mom read and my dad slept. We had a wonderful time there.

blocks.title: Ngồi ghế đá công viên uống cà phê

chunks: four or five hours a day
items.en: I went to the park after lunch. I sat on a bench with a cup of coffee. It was relaxing. I spent about an hour there and went back home. When I was little, I liked playing at the park. I used to spend four or five hours a day at the park. I feel comfortable when I’m there.

blocks.title: Cho chim ăn ở công viên

chunks: so I decided to feed some birds.
items.en: I went to the park yesterday. It was relaxing to sit on a bench. I had crackers with me so I decided to feed some birds. After feeding the birds for two minutes, a flock of them came to where I was. They made me feel nervous. I left the park.

blocks.title: Thuê xe đạp đi trong công viên

chunks: We also had a great conversation.
I like going to the park
items.en: I like riding a bike through the park. Last weekend, I went to the park with my friend. We rented two bicycles and rode them for a few hours. It was enjoyable. After riding the bikes, we sat on a bench and rested. We also had a great conversation. I like going to the park with my friend.

blocks.title: Có thông báo tìm trẻ lạc ở công viên

chunks: for me to help the little boy.
items.en: I go to the park twice a week. Yesterday, I saw a child who was lost there. He was crying in front of a tree. I took him to the main office. They made an announcement to help locate his mom. His mom showed up 5 minutes after the announcement. It was meaningful for me to help the little boy.
notes: đưa ai đó đến đâu đó

blocks.title: Công viên có nhiều thứ để ngắm

chunks: The park is a nice place
items.en: There is a big park in my neighborhood. It is a 10-minute walk from my house. In the park, you can see a garden, some statues, and even a small pond. The park is a nice place to spend time with my friends and family. I go there often.

blocks.title: Công viên có sân chơi

chunks: It is always crowded with little kids.
items.en: There is a big playground at the park. The playground has slides, swings and a jungle gym. It is always crowded with little kids. I used to play in the playground all the time. It was my favorite place in my neighborhood.

blocks.title: Bị ướt mưa vì dự báo thời tiết sai

chunks: in the middle of the day
when the weather forecast is wrong.
items.en: It was supposed to be sunny today. However, it rained in the middle of the day and I got wet. It is frustrating when the weather forecast is wrong. I will just have to carry around an umbrella in my bag all the time.
notes: được cho là phải làm gì, lẽ ra phải làm gì
in the middle of the day

blocks.title: Suýt gặp tai nạn vì sương mù dày đặc

chunks: and it was hard to see.
I almost got in an accident
items.en: It rained last night. It was really foggy this morning and it was hard to see. I almost got in an accident twice. I had a hard time driving to work. I hate going to work when it’s foggy in the morning.

blocks.title: Bị say nắng khi xem trận bóng đá

chunks: I went to see a soccer game
I got sick from the heat
in the middle of the game.
items.en: It was really hot today. I went to see a soccer game and sat outside for three hours. I got sick from the heat and I felt so tired. I had to leave in the middle of the game.

blocks.title: Vì bụi vàng nên phải đeo khẩu trang và đi taxi

chunks: so I put a mask on
My school is far from my house,
but I never take a cab.
so I am thinking of carpooling
items.en: Yellow dust hit Korea a week ago, so I put a mask on when I go out. My clothes get so dirty when I go outside. My school is far from my house, but I never take a cab. However, because of the yellow dust, I took a cab this morning. It was very expensive, so I am thinking of carpooling with my friends tomorrow.

blocks.title: Gần đây chênh lệch nhiệt độ ngày đêm rất lớn

chunks: there has been a wide temperature range
When I jog in the morning,
But it is hot during the day.
items.en: Recently, there has been a wide temperature range during the day. When I jog in the morning, it is cold. But it is hot during the day. Yesterday, when I was coming home from school, it was quite chilly. I caught a cold.

blocks.title: Nhà kính của bà bị hỏng vì mưa đá

chunks: The vinyl greenhouse at my grandma’s
and it takes a long time.
I am going to my grandma’s
items.en: The vinyl greenhouse at my grandma’s collapsed because of hail. I heard it is tough to rebuild a greenhouse and it takes a long time. I think it is important to use strong materials to build a greenhouse. I am going to my grandma’s this weekend to help her rebuild it.

blocks.title: Đi làm muộn vì tuyết

chunks: The streets were covered in snow
to walk to the subway station.
items.en: It snowed a lot last night. The streets were covered in snow so people couldn’t drive. I was late for work this morning and it was frustrating to walk to the subway station.

blocks.title: Không đi học vì đường bị ngập

chunks: So I couldn’t go to school
items.en: Heavy rain flooded streets in my town over the weekend. So I couldn’t go to school today. I talked on the phone with a friend for three hours and watched TV for another three hours. It was relaxing.

blocks.title: Tâm trạng bị chi phối bởi thời tiết

chunks: and am tempted to go outside.
when it is rainy and cloudy,
items.en: When it is nice out, I feel energized and am tempted to go outside. However, when it is rainy and cloudy, I feel lazy and begin to get depressed. I think weather affects people’s moods.
notes: cảm thấy tràn đầy năng lượng
bị cám dỗ để làm gì

blocks.title: Bạn không chịu buông micro

chunks: I went to a singing room
One of my friends started to sing
I am never going to sing
items.en: I sing to release stress. Last night, I went to a singing room with some friends. One of my friends started to sing and he wouldn’t stop. It was not enjoyable. I am never going to sing with him again.

blocks.title: Cách âm kém nên nghe hết tiếng phòng bên

chunks: I went to a singing room
items.en: A couple of weeks ago, I went to a singing room in my neighborhood. The soundproof facilities at the singing room were not good. I could hear everything from the next room. It was bothersome.

blocks.title: Buồn thì đi hát karaoke

chunks: I go to a singing room.
I went to a singing room
items.en: When I am depressed, I go to a singing room. I like to sing loud there. When I do it, I feel better. I went to a singing room a week ago, and the next morning, my voice was gone.

blocks.title: Vừa nhảy vừa gõ trống lắc chơi ở phòng karaoke

chunks: When I am at a singing room,
When one of my friends sings,
It makes everyone in the room laugh.
items.en: When I am at a singing room, I get very excited. When one of my friends sings, I dance and play the tambourine. It is fun to shake it while dancing. It makes everyone in the room laugh.

blocks.title: Tắt nhạc khi bạn đang hát

chunks: I went to a singing room
She is not a good singer.
I just turned the song off.
I didn’t even feel sorry for her.
items.en: I went to a singing room with my friend. She is not a good singer. It was frustrating to hear her singing. I couldn’t stand it anymore. I just turned the song off. I didn’t even feel sorry for her.
notes: cảm thấy áy náy với ai đó

blocks.title: Chủ quán karaoke quen tặng thêm giờ hát

chunks: I go to this singing room
with the same group of friends
to go to a singing room
items.en: I go to this singing room once a week. Since I go there with the same group of friends quite often, the owner gives me more time for free. She gave us 30 minutes as a bonus last time we went. It is fun to go to a singing room with my friends.

blocks.title: Đi vệ sinh về nhầm sang phòng khác

chunks: and went into the wrong room.
I ended up calling my friend
to find where our room was.
items.en: I came back from the restroom. I got confused about the room number and went into the wrong room. I was embarrassed. I ended up calling my friend to find where our room was.

blocks.title: Tôi hát mà chẳng ai để ý

chunks: Everyone had to listen to my song.
items.en: I was trying to sing but everyone was talking. I thought they were rude. I turned up the volume on the microphone. Everyone had to listen to my song. It was fun to sing in front of everyone.

blocks.title: Hết giờ nên đã đặt thêm giờ

chunks: I went to a singing room
we were running out of time.
items.en: I went to a singing room after dinner last night. After singing more than 20 songs, we were running out of time. So we paid extra and added another hour.

blocks.title: Say rượu ngủ quên trong phòng karaoke

chunks: After finishing my friend’s birthday dinner,
we all went to a singing room
Everyone was having a lot of fun,
items.en: After finishing my friend’s birthday dinner we all went to a singing room near the restaurant. Everyone was having a lot of fun but I got really drunk and fell asleep in the singing room.

blocks.title: Bà bị chứng mất ngủ hành hạ

chunks: her to be healthy and happy.
items.en: My grandma suffers from insomnia really badly. She usually takes some sleeping pills to go to sleep. I feel really bad because she is so old. I just want her to be healthy and happy.

blocks.title: Luôn tỉnh giấc giữa đêm

items.en: I always wake up during the night. I wake up at least twice and it is hard to fall back to sleep. I am thinking of taking sleeping pills. I really want to sleep through the night.

blocks.title: Chỉ ngủ được 4 tiếng vì mải chơi game

chunks: because I only slept for four hours
items.en: I almost fell asleep during class because I only slept for four hours last night. Actually, I played a computer game for 5 hours. I am so tired now. I need to go home as soon as possible.

blocks.title: Không dậy nổi dù chuông báo thức reo

chunks: I usually fall into a deep sleep.
So I always have a hard time
and I was late for school.
items.en: I usually fall into a deep sleep. So I always have a hard time waking up once I fall asleep. I need to set more than three alarms before going to bed. This morning, all of the three alarms went off but I heard nothing and I was late for school.

blocks.title: Nghiến răng khi ngủ

chunks: I really want to stop this
items.en: I grind my teeth in my sleep. I think it not only causes damage to my teeth but also disturbs my sleep. I really want to stop this but I don’t know how. I’m thinking of going to a dentist.
notes: not only A but also B

blocks.title: Em trai ngáy to đến mức không ngủ được

chunks: I sleep in the same room
he needed to see a doctor,
so I told him to do so.
and he would not go see a doctor.
items.en: I sleep in the same room as my brother and he snores while he sleeps. It is so loud that I can’t fall asleep. I thought he needed to see a doctor, so I told him to do so. He said he never snored and he would not go see a doctor. It is ridiculous.

blocks.title: Hồi nhỏ hay nói mớ

items.en: When I was young, I used to talk in my sleep. I don’t remember what I said but my mom told me I always talked in my sleep. As I grew up, I don’t think I talk in my sleep anymore.

blocks.title: Hồi nhỏ hay tè dầm khi ngủ

chunks: that I woke up in the morning
items.en: When I was a kid, I once wet the bed while sleeping. I remember that I woke up in the morning and cried. My mom said it was okay but I felt embarrassed.

blocks.title: Nhạy cảm nên có người bên cạnh là không ngủ được

chunks: because I am a light sleeper.
when someone else tosses and turns
because I can’t share a bed
items.en: I need to sleep alone because I am a light sleeper. I easily wake up when someone else tosses and turns next to me in bed. I don’t think I can get married because I can’t share a bed with another person.
notes: người ngủ nhạy, dễ tỉnh giấc

blocks.title: Phải ngủ ít nhất 10 tiếng

chunks: that I wouldn’t be able to function
if I only got 5 hours of sleep.
items.en: I usually get tired unless I get at least 10 hours of sleep. My dad only sleeps for 5 hours a day. I am pretty sure that I wouldn’t be able to function if I only got 5 hours of sleep.

blocks.title: Uống rượu rất nhiều

chunks: So when three of us meet,
items.en: I drink like a fish. When I drink, I drink at least 3 bottles of soju. Most of my friends all drink a lot. So when three of us meet, we usually drink 10 bottles of soju between us. The funny thing is that we see each other almost every day.

blocks.title: Uống rượu đến mất trí nhớ

chunks: that I didn’t do anything stupid.
I am going to stop drinking.
items.en: I drank a lot and blacked out last night. I literally don’t remember how I got home. I just hope that I didn’t do anything stupid. I am going to stop drinking.
notes: mất trí nhớ tạm thời (do say)

blocks.title: Có thói quen trả tiền rượu khi say

chunks: but my friends love me doing it.
They always make me get drunk.
items.en: I have this bad habit that whenever I get drunk, I pay for the drinks. I always regret it in the morning, but my friends love me doing it. They always make me get drunk. They are bad.

blocks.title: Uống nhiều rượu rồi nôn ngoài đường

chunks: I went to have a drink
and I ended up throwing up
items.en: Last night, I went to have a drink with my friends. I skipped dinner and just drank soju. After drinking about two bottles of soju, I felt sick and I ended up throwing up on the street. I was embarrassed.

blocks.title: Tuyệt đối không uống pha trộn các loại rượu

chunks: I once had soju with beer
items.en: I can’t stand mixing drinks because I get drunk easily. It also gives me the worst hangover the next morning. I once had soju with beer and it almost killed me. I have never mixed drinks since then.
notes: cơn say, dư vị khó chịu sau khi say

blocks.title: Đặc biệt yếu với rượu gạo makgeolli

chunks: when I drink Korean rice wine.
but it just gets me drunk
I once drank a bottle of it
items.en: I get drunk easily when I drink Korean rice wine. I don’t know why but it just gets me drunk so easily. I once drank a bottle of it and blacked out. Since then, I try not to drink too much of it.

blocks.title: Khi uống rượu không lái xe đi

chunks: so I have to call someone
I don’t want to spend my money
on having somebody drive for me.
So I just leave my car
items.en: I don’t drive when I drink, so I have to call someone to drive for me. I don’t want to spend my money on having somebody drive for me. So I just leave my car at home.
notes: bắt, nhờ ai đó làm gì

blocks.title: Uống rượu thâu đêm ở buổi họp lớp cấp ba

chunks: I went to my high school reunion.
My friends and I were so glad
items.en: Last Saturday, I went to my high school reunion. My friends and I were so glad to see each other after all these years that we ended up drinking until the next morning.

blocks.title: Giải rượu bằng canh giải rượu vào hôm sau

chunks: I had a really bad hangover
I met up with my friend
and went straight to a restaurant
items.en: I had a really bad hangover this morning from last night. I met up with my friend that I drank with and went straight to a restaurant to relieve the hangover. I felt much better after having some soup.

blocks.title: Chỉ uống một chút cũng đỏ mặt

chunks: even when I drink a little.
and asks if I am drunk
so I don’t like to drink.
items.en: My face turns red even when I drink a little. When I get red, everyone looks at me and asks if I am drunk though I am not drunk. It is embarrassing so I don’t like to drink.

blocks.title: Đã khóc khi xem phim

chunks: that I cried my eyes out.
items.en: The movie was so sad that I cried my eyes out. My friend said I embarrassed him. I can’t believe he didn’t cry. I think he is cold-hearted.

blocks.title: Chọn theo bài đánh giá phim rồi thất vọng

chunks: I went to see a movie
items.en: I usually pick a movie that has great reviews. Last weekend I went to see a movie which had good reviews, but it was very disappointing. I will not pick movies by reviews anymore.

blocks.title: Không thưởng thức trọn vẹn phim vì mải đọc phụ đề

chunks: but I actually couldn’t enjoy the movie
what the main actress looked like.
items.en: I went to see this French movie that won at Cannes. I was very excited but I actually couldn’t enjoy the movie because I was too busy reading the subtitles. I don’t even remember what the main actress looked like.
notes: at Cannes (=at the Cannes Film Festival)

blocks.title: Phim mình thích xem mãi không chán!

items.en: I don’t get bored watching my favorite movies twice. Actually, I download movies that I like and watch them over and over again. I watched The Usual Suspects again last night. I don’t even remember how many times I watched that movie.

blocks.title: Đã mua nhạc phim vì rất thích

chunks: that one of my favorite musicians
items.en: I really liked the soundtrack for the movie so I bought the CD right after the movie. It turned out that one of my favorite musicians had produced the album. I listen to it every day.

blocks.title: Chỉ có rạp chiếu phim 4D

chunks: But the screen was so small
so I just went back home
items.en: Spiderman 3 came out and I got so excited. I went to the theater in my neighborhood. But the screen was so small and they only had seats for 4D movies left. I don’t like 4D movies so I just went back home instead.

blocks.title: Xem phim xong nhớ tới mối tình đầu

chunks: that it reminded me of a girl
I couldn’t stop thinking about her
items.en: The movie was so touching that it reminded me of a girl who was my first love. I couldn’t stop thinking about her after watching it.
notes: làm ai đó nhớ đến điều gì

blocks.title: Bỏ về giữa chừng vì phim quá tàn bạo

chunks: I went to see this zombie movie
There were so many cruel scenes
items.en: I went to see this zombie movie last night. There were so many cruel scenes in that movie that I couldn’t stand it. I just left the theater in the middle of it. The movie had put me in a bad mood.
notes: put A in a bad mood
làm ai đó khó chịu, tâm trạng xấu

blocks.title: Người ngồi trước quá cao

chunks: The person in front of me
that I couldn’t see the screen very well.
my friend was even taller than him,
items.en: The person in front of me was so tall that I couldn’t see the screen very well. It was very distracting. I thought my friend was even taller than him, so I asked him to switch seats with me.

blocks.title: Đã ngủ gật khi xem phim

chunks: I am not a fan of documentary films.
items.en: My friend took me to see this documentary film. I am not a fan of documentary films. I only watch action movies. The movie was so boring that I dozed off in the middle of it.

blocks.title: Phát hiện sợi tóc trong món ăn

chunks: they brought me a new dish.
items.en: My family was eating at a restaurant. I found a hair in my food. It was gross. I complained, and then they brought me a new dish. I didn’t pay for it.

blocks.title: Nhà hàng Ý ngon nhưng phải chờ lâu

chunks: but I always have to wait
So when I don’t have enough time,
items.en: I like this Italian restaurant in my neighborhood. They have good food but I always have to wait for 30 minutes after I order. So when I don’t have enough time, I don’t go there.

blocks.title: Quán ăn cạnh nhà rẻ và nhiều

chunks: The restaurant next to my house
They don’t have the best food either,
items.en: The restaurant next to my house is not fancy at all. They don’t have the best food either, but it is cheap and it comes out on a huge dish. I can never finish it by myself.

blocks.title: Nhân viên nhà hàng thân thiện thì cho tip cũng không tiếc

chunks: My dad always gives them a tip
items.en: I like going to this Japanese restaurant near the Gangnam area. Their staff is so kind and they know how to treat customers. I always feel good after eating there. My dad always gives them a tip when he leaves the restaurant. I think they deserve it.

blocks.title: Món ăn kèm và nước tự phục vụ!

chunks: When the waitress got my order,
water and side dishes are put
and that we need to go get it
when I had to stand up
items.en: When the waitress got my order, I asked her for water. She said water and side dishes are put in front of the kitchen and that we need to go get it ourselves. At first it was fine, but it got annoying when I had to stand up during the meal.
notes: nhận đơn đặt hàng của ai đó

blocks.title: Món ra khác với món đã gọi

chunks: The waiter got my order wrong
and brought me the wrong dish.
but he brought me seafood rice
I didn’t feel like waiting again,
so I just ate the rice.
items.en: The waiter got my order wrong and brought me the wrong dish. I ordered seafood noodles, but he brought me seafood rice instead. I didn’t feel like waiting again, so I just ate the rice.

blocks.title: Tiệm pizza không ngon như lời đồn

chunks: that the restaurant was very famous
for making great pizza and pasta.
and waited for half an hour.
the food was actually not that good.
items.en: I heard that the restaurant was very famous for making great pizza and pasta. I went there with my friends and waited for half an hour. However, the food was actually not that good. It was so different from what I had heard.

blocks.title: Jjajangmyeon hay jjamppong, đó mới là vấn đề!

chunks: Whenever I go to a Chinese restaurant,
for me to decide what to eat.
between noodles with Chinese sauce or seafood noodle soup.
items.en: Whenever I go to a Chinese restaurant, it takes forever for me to decide what to eat. I can’t decide between noodles with Chinese sauce or seafood noodle soup. I always ask my friend to order those two and we share them.
notes: giữa cái này và cái kia

blocks.title: Cà phê nhiều đường ở quán ăn là kẻ thù của bố!

chunks: My dad is on a diet.
We went to a Korean barbeque restaurant
had a lot of sugar in it,
so my dad was not allowed to drink it.
items.en: My dad is on a diet. My mom told him to stop eating sweets, so he has actually quit for three days now. We went to a Korean barbeque restaurant this evening. The thing is that they always give coffee to their diners after the meal. The coffee they gave us had a lot of sugar in it, so my dad was not allowed to drink it.

blocks.title: Đã chơi cầu lông hơn 10 năm

chunks: My dad got me a badminton racquet
items.en: My dad got me a badminton racquet for my 15th birthday gift. I was very excited. My dad taught me how to play badminton. I still enjoy playing badminton. I have been playing it for over 10 years.

blocks.title: Là người nghiện thể thao, dù bị thương vẫn tập

chunks: I can’t rest in order to recover.
items.en: I am addicted to exercise. I get moody or angry when I miss my workout. My right knee was injured from running last month. However, I continue to exercise. I can’t rest in order to recover.

blocks.title: Đổ mồ hôi khi tập thể dục xong thấy sảng khoái

chunks: when I kick up the cardio
items.en: I love running. I feel so refreshed when I kick up the cardio and sweat it out. I also ran this morning and my clothes got soaked in sweat. I couldn’t feel more refreshed.

blocks.title: Thích môn thể thao đồng đội như bóng đá, bóng chày

chunks: I prefer playing sports with others
I love playing soccer and baseball.
when I play sports with my friends.
and I get to have great experiences
items.en: I prefer playing sports with others to playing alone. I love playing soccer and baseball. It is more fun when I play sports with my friends. It builds up teamwork and I get to have great experiences with my friends.
notes: thích cái này hơn cái kia
xây dựng tinh thần đồng đội

blocks.title: Bơi lội giúp khỏe hơn và tính cách cũng thay đổi

chunks: I also used to get sick often.
items.en: When I was a kid, I was really shy. I also used to get sick often. I didn’t have many friends. My mom signed me up for swimming lessons and I really liked them. About a year later, I became healthy and I wasn’t so shy anymore.
notes: đăng ký cho ai đó vào cái gì

blocks.title: Quyết định đi cầu thang bộ thay vì thang máy

chunks: I don’t have time to exercise.
I could go to the gym
I decided to take the stairs
items.en: I don’t have time to exercise. I could go to the gym after work, but I am usually exhausted by then and go straight home. I decided to take the stairs instead of using the elevator. Taking the stairs burns calories.

blocks.title: Thích chạy bộ vì dễ thực hiện

chunks: is because I don’t need to wear sportswear.
I sometimes wear a jogging outfit,
if I am in comfortable clothes and shoes.
items.en: One of the reasons I like jogging is because I don’t need to wear sportswear. I sometimes wear a jogging outfit, but I don’t have to. I can jog if I am in comfortable clothes and shoes. That’s all I need.

blocks.title: Tốn nhiều tiền cho dụng cụ bóng chày

chunks: When I was in middle school,
I joined my school’s baseball team.
There was so much to purchase
items.en: When I was in middle school, I joined my school’s baseball team. The coach gave me the equipment list for baseball at my first practice. There was so much to purchase and I knew it would cost a lot. I couldn’t buy them all so I just borrowed some from my friends.

blocks.title: Công viên khu phố có các dụng cụ thể dục

chunks: to take a walk or ride a bike.
Whenever I go to the park,
items.en: There is a park in my neighborhood. I go there to take a walk or ride a bike. The park also has some exercise machines. Whenever I go to the park, I see many old people using the machines.

blocks.title: Sếp gặp tai nạn

chunks: My boss called me this morning.
He was in a minor accident
items.en: My boss called me this morning. He was in a minor accident on his way to work. I asked him if he was okay and he said he was fine. He also told me to prepare the meeting by myself.

blocks.title: Xe số tự động dễ lái hơn

chunks: I took the driver’s license test
for both automatic and stick shift cars.
how to drive both of them.
my first car was an automatic
items.en: I took the driver’s license test for both automatic and stick shift cars. I know how to drive both of them. However, my first car was an automatic and now I hardly get to drive stick shift cars. Automatic cars are much easier to drive.

blocks.title: Mệt vì phải đạp ga liên tục

chunks: I was so excited to see her
but because of the terrible traffic
I had to step on the accelerator
when I got to my grandma’s.
items.en: My family went to visit my grandma’s house last Saturday. I was so excited to see her but because of the terrible traffic I had to step on the accelerator for 4 straight hours. I was exhausted when I got to my grandma’s.

blocks.title: Mệt vì cứ phải đạp thắng rồi nhả liên tục

chunks: The driver in front of me
between his car and the car in front of him.
stepping on and off the brake
because of his poor driving skills.
items.en: The driver in front of me was the worst driver ever. I think he can’t calculate the distance between his car and the car in front of him. I had to keep stepping on and off the brake because of his poor driving skills. It was tiring.
notes: step on and off the brake

blocks.title: Rẽ phải mà không bật xi-nhan

chunks: I forgot to turn on the blinker
and he didn’t reduce his speed.
items.en: I forgot to turn on the blinker and made a right turn. The car behind me thought I was going straight and he didn’t reduce his speed. He ended up hitting me from behind. It was my fault.

blocks.title: Vượt xe chạy trước chậm chạp

chunks: On my way to my grandma’s house,
and the car in front of me
items.en: I enjoy driving fast. On my way to my grandma’s house, I took the highway. I was driving in the passing lane and the car in front of me was going so slow. I flashed my high beams to make the driver move, but he didn’t notice. I just overtook the car in the end.

blocks.title: Lái xe say rượu nên đi lạng lách giữa các làn

chunks: the car in front of me
items.en: Last night I was driving home from work, the car in front of me kept changing lanes. At first, I didn’t take it seriously, but the car ended up hitting a tree. The driver was driving drunk.

blocks.title: Cần gạt nước không hoạt động

chunks: so I turned on the windshield wipers,
items.en: It suddenly started to rain, so I turned on the windshield wipers, but they were not working. I couldn’t see anything. I knew something was wrong, so I went straight to a car repair center.
notes: cần gạt nước kính chắn gió

blocks.title: Em gái đỗ bằng lái xe ngay lần đầu

chunks: and went to take the test.
that she passed the written test,
I was so proud of her.
items.en: My younger sister wanted to get a driver’s license. She studied for two months and went to take the test. It turned out that she passed the written test, the skill test, and the driving test, all on her first try. I was so proud of her.

blocks.title: Luôn thắt dây an toàn khi đi cao tốc

chunks: I don’t like to wear a seatbelt
when I drive on the highway.
like I have to wear it
regardless of where I’m sitting in the car.
items.en: I don’t like to wear a seatbelt in the car because it feels restricting. However, I always wear a seatbelt when I drive on the highway. I feel like I have to wear it regardless of where I’m sitting in the car.

blocks.title: Luôn đỗ xe bằng cách lùi

chunks: to come out of the parking lot
items.en: When I tried to come out of the parking lot at the mall, I didn’t see the car passing behind me and almost hit it. Since then, I always park backwards. In that case, I won’t be at risk of reversing into unknown traffic.

blocks.title: Bị phạt vé vượt tốc độ trên cao tốc

chunks: I didn’t want to be late
When I was cruising down the highway
making record time on my commute,
a police car pulled me over
on the side of the road.
items.en: I slept in today. I didn’t want to be late for work, so I rushed. When I was cruising down the highway making record time on my commute, a police car pulled me over on the side of the road. I got a speeding ticket.
notes: chạy êm ru trên cao tốc
yêu cầu ai đó tấp vào lề

blocks.title: Quyết tâm tuyệt đối không lái xe khi say rượu

chunks: that one of my middle school friends
got hit by a drunk driver.
I decided not to drink and drive
items.en: I just heard the news that one of my middle school friends got hit by a drunk driver. I couldn’t believe it because he still lives in my neighborhood and I often see him on the street. I decided not to drink and drive ever again.

blocks.title: Tài xế taxi bị phạt vì vượt đèn đỏ

chunks: I didn’t want to be late
The cab driver tried to go fast
items.en: I woke up late today. I didn’t want to be late so I rushed outside and hailed a cab. The cab driver tried to go fast and he got a ticket for running a red light. Many people run red lights. I had no luck this morning.

blocks.title: Suýt gặp nạn vì không thấy xe qua gương chiếu hậu

chunks: so I signaled I was turning left
and looked at my left mirror.
There were no cars to my left
because I didn’t see the car
items.en: I decided to change lanes, so I signaled I was turning left and looked at my left mirror. There were no cars to my left so I changed lanes, but the car behind me honked at me. I freaked because I didn’t see the car through my mirror.

blocks.title: Bật đèn pha thì khó nhìn thấy người

chunks: because when I turn onthe headlights,
if a person ison the road.
so I turned on the headlights.
I had to pay careful attention
items.en: I don’t like driving in the dark because when I turn on the headlights, it is hard to see if a person is on the road. On my way back home last night, it got dark so I turned on the headlights. I had to pay careful attention and it was tiring.

blocks.title: Phải gọi công ty bảo hiểm vì hết bình ắc quy

chunks: when I turned the key in my ignition.
It seemed like my car battery was dead
items.en: My car would not start when I turned the key in my ignition. Everything but the engine seemed to be functioning. It seemed like my car battery was dead so I had to call my car insurance company.
notes: turn the key in one’s ignition
vặn chìa khóa khởi động xe

blocks.title: Không đỗ được xe trước cửa hàng tiện lợi vì xe sau bấm còi

chunks: I wanted to get bottled water
The store didn’t have a parking lot
right in front of the store.
When I pulled over and got out,
I had to get back into the car
items.en: I wanted to get bottled water from a convenience store. The store didn’t have a parking lot so I just pulled over right in front of the store. When I pulled over and got out, the car behind me honked at me. I had to get back into the car and drive away.

blocks.title: Lấy số thứ tự rồi chờ đến lượt

chunks: I don’t like to waste my time
so I went to the bank
I had to take a number
items.en: I don’t like to waste my time at a bank, so I went to the bank at 9 a.m. I was surprised to see some people who were already there. I had to take a number and wait.

blocks.title: Thường xuyên dùng máy ATM

chunks: and I couldn’t find my wallet
So I often use an ATM
items.en: I once lost my wallet on the subway. I had 100,000 won in cash at that time and I couldn’t find my wallet at all. Since then, I only carry debit cards in my wallet. So I often use an ATM to withdraw some cash.

blocks.title: Đã mở sổ tiết kiệm mới

chunks: When I started my new job,
items.en: When I started my new job, my boss told me to open a bank account at the ABC bank for payroll. I had to change the bank account I used for payroll.

blocks.title: Đã cập nhật sổ tiết kiệm sau một thời gian dài

chunks: that I hadn’t updated my bank account
items.en: I went to the bank to wire some money to my mom. The bank clerk told me that I hadn’t updated my bank account in quite some time. I asked her to do it for me, and then it took 5 minutes to finish updating it.
notes: cập nhật sổ tiết kiệm, tài khoản

blocks.title: Luôn dùng ATM của ngân hàng mình giao dịch

chunks: so I looked for an ATM.
I don’t like to withdraw cash
because they charge me a fee
items.en: I needed some cash, so I looked for an ATM. I don’t like to withdraw cash through an ATM that’s not my bank because they charge me a fee to use another bank’s ATM.

blocks.title: Chuyển tiền cho bạn qua ATM

chunks: that I would wire her the money.
so I just used the ATM
items.en: My friend bought some concert tickets online. I told her that I would wire her the money. I didn’t have enough time to go to the bank, so I just used the ATM in my building to wire the money.

blocks.title: Tài khoản bị khóa vì nhập sai mật khẩu

chunks: I forgot my debit card PIN number
I had to go to the bank
and get a new PIN number.
items.en: I forgot my debit card PIN number and entered the wrong number three times. I was not allowed to deposit or withdraw through the ATM machine. I had to go to the bank and get a new PIN number.

blocks.title: Làm mất thẻ ghi nợ nên đã xin cấp lại ở ngân hàng

chunks: I called the bank right away
and reported my debit card stolen.
items.en: I lost my debit card. I called the bank right away and reported my debit card stolen. I went to the bank the next day and got it reissued. It was a bummer.

blocks.title: Đã được cấp thẻ tín dụng đầu tiên

chunks: I got my first credit card.
of getting a department store credit card
but they had high annual fees.
So I just went to the local bank
and had my first credit card issued there.
items.en: Last month, I got my first credit card. I was thinking of getting a department store credit card but they had high annual fees. So I just went to the local bank and had my first credit card issued there.
notes: trung tâm mua sắm, bách hóa

blocks.title: Đang tiết kiệm để đi du lịch châu Âu

chunks: I have been saving up 100,000 won
items.en: Since 2020, I have been saving up 100,000 won each month for a trip to Europe. I am planning to withdraw my installment savings in 2022. It is best not to close it before the account has matured.

blocks.title: Ai đó đã lấy trộm xe đạp của tôi

chunks: and l liked it a lot.
items.en: I got a bike for my 18th birthday. It was my first bike and l liked it a lot. One day, I parked my bike near the subway station, and someone stole it. I cried for a week.

blocks.title: Định đi xe đạp lúc đi làm về nhưng đã từ bỏ

chunks: I hate getting on a packed bus
to ride a bike to work.
I got a new bike and a helmet
and was so ready for it.
the bike lanes were not built so well,
items.en: I hate getting on a packed bus during rush hour, so I decided to ride a bike to work. I got a new bike and a helmet and was so ready for it. However, the bike lanes were not built so well, so I gave up on riding it to work.

blocks.title: Đã bóp phanh nhưng suýt ngã

chunks: and almost got in a bike accident
and got some cuts and bruises.
items.en: I was riding downhill at a high speed and almost got in a bike accident last weekend. I squeezed the brakes quickly. I avoided the accident, but fell over and got some cuts and bruises.
notes: ride downhill at a high speed
đi xuống dốc với tốc độ cao
bị trầy xước và bầm tím

blocks.title: Bố đã giữ phía sau xe đạp cho

chunks: my dad would let the bike go
items.en: When I first learned how to ride a bike, it was hard to keep my balance. My dad held my bike from the back and I rode it for an hour. After an hour, my dad would let the bike go without telling me. I thought he was still holding it but he wasn’t. I felt really good.

blocks.title: Lắp bánh phụ để tập rồi sau đó tháo ra

chunks: When I was six years old,
my dad got me a bike
my dad took the training wheels off.
and it was so much fun.
items.en: When I was six years old, my dad got me a bike with training wheels. I was so excited and rode the bike every day. About three months later, my dad took the training wheels off. At first it was not easy to keep balance, but soon, I got it and it was so much fun.

blocks.title: Xích xe đạp cứ bị tuột

chunks: When I was going up a hill,
I put the bike into 1st gear
I stopped and put it back on.
a bit further up the hill
but then it came off again.
items.en: Recently, I bought a secondhand bike. When I was going up a hill, I put the bike into 1st gear but the chain came off. I stopped and put it back on. I rode again a bit further up the hill but then it came off again.

blocks.title: Có vẻ xe đạp bị trục trặc

chunks: I have to put so much effort
in getting my bike up hills
items.en: I have to put so much effort in getting my bike up hills that aren’t even that steep. I am an athletic person, so I am wondering if there is something wrong with my bicycle.
notes: dồn nhiều công sức vào việc gì
khỏe mạnh, cơ bắp săn chắc

blocks.title: Đã ngã khỏi xe đạp

chunks: One kid came out of nowhere
and ran in front of me.
but then I fell off my bike.
I got some cuts and bruises.
items.en: Last weekend, I went to the park to ride my bike. There were many kids playing in the park. One kid came out of nowhere and ran in front of me. I tried to avoid him, but then I fell off my bike. I got some cuts and bruises.
notes: vết trầy xước và bầm tím

blocks.title: Xe đạp của tôi có thể chuyển 10 cấp số

chunks: I usually put it into a low gear
when I ride at high speeds
I put the gear up again.
items.en: I have a bicycle with 10 gears. When I ride it, I usually put it into a low gear when I start off. I increase my rear gear as I speed up. When I slow down or approach a hill, I put the gear down and then when I ride at high speeds or downhill, I put the gear up again.

blocks.title: Đá máy bán hàng tự động vì nó nuốt tiền của tôi

chunks: and tried to get a cold soda.
but the vending machine didn’t respond.
items.en: The weather was boiling hot and I was so thirsty. I found a vending machine and tried to get a cold soda. I put some coins in, but the vending machine didn’t respond. I was so upset and gave it a kick. It spat out my coins.

blocks.title: Coca đã hết hàng

chunks: I went to the vending machine
if I didn’t get him his Coke,
items.en: My professor told me to get him a Coke. I went to the vending machine right outside the classroom. However, it was out of Coke. I knew he would be upset if I didn’t get him his Coke, so I ran upstairs to get one.

blocks.title: Có thứ gì đó lẫn trong cà phê máy bán tự động

chunks: When I tried to drink it,
I saw something in my coffee
items.en: I got a coffee from a vending machine. When I tried to drink it, I saw something in my coffee and threw it away. I wasn’t sure what that was, but it certainly looked disgusting.
notes: cà phê từ máy bán tự động

blocks.title: Máy chỉ ra cà phê mà không có cốc

chunks: There was a red signal flashing
So I put some coins in
The vending machine made a little noise
and then the coffee came out
