items.en: I tried to buy coffee from a vending machine. There was a red signal flashing next to the coffee button but I didn’t know what that meant. So I put some coins in and pushed the button. The vending machine made a little noise and then the coffee came out without a cup. It was ridiculous.

blocks.title: Không nhận được tiền thối

chunks: I put in a thousand won bill
and I was supposed to get 300 won
it did not give me the change.
items.en: I put in a thousand won bill and I was supposed to get 300 won in change. However, it did not give me the change. I was upset. I could have called the customer service center, but I knew it would take more than 10 minutes to solve this problem. I decided not to call and gave up my 300 won.

blocks.title: Cà phê máy bán tự động có vị lạ

chunks: I won a coffee on a bet,
to buy me a cup of coffee.
The vending machine even had cafe mocha,
so I pushed the cafe mocha button.
items.en: I won a coffee on a bet, so my friend took me to a vending machine to buy me a cup of coffee. The vending machine even had cafe mocha, so I pushed the cafe mocha button. When the coffee came out, I tried one sip and it tasted really weird. It didn’t taste like coffee. I just threw it out.
notes: thắng trong một vụ cá cược

blocks.title: Hôm nay uống tận 10 ly cà phê máy tự động

chunks: three cups of coffee a day.
for something that I didn’t do.
and I drank 10 cups of coffee
I won’t be able to sleep tonight.
items.en: I usually drink three cups of coffee a day. However, when I get stressed, I tend to drink more. My boss yelled at me at work this morning for something that I didn’t do. I felt so stressed and I drank 10 cups of coffee from a vending machine throughout the day. I won’t be able to sleep tonight.

blocks.title: Người bạn Mỹ của tôi mê cà phê máy bán tự động

chunks: I am a fan of coffee
and got him a milk coffee.
items.en: I am a fan of coffee from vending machines. It is cheap and it tastes so good. One day, I took my American friend to a vending machine and got him a milk coffee. He loved it so much that now he drinks it every day. He is addicted to it.

blocks.title: Chỉ có tờ 5.000 won nên không mua được nước

chunks: I only had a 5,000 won bill
but the vending machine only accepted
items.en: It was so hot outside and I was very thirsty. I found a vending machine and I was so excited to get a cold drink. However, I only had a 5,000 won bill but the vending machine only accepted up to 1,000 won bills. I had to walk for another 30 minutes to find a store.

blocks.title: Tìm giá thấp nhất mỗi lít

chunks: Gas prices keep on going up,
and look for the lowest one
the lowest gas pricewas at a gas station
items.en: Gas prices keep on going up, so I always check the gas price per liter and look for the lowest one in my area. Yesterday, however, the lowest gas price was at a gas station near my home.

blocks.title: Không tìm được nút mở nắp bình xăng

chunks: I went to the gas station
items.en: I went to the gas station to put gas in my mom’s car. It was my first time to drive her car, so I was nervous. When the guy asked me to open the gas tank, it took me a while to find the button to open it up. I felt so embarrassed.

blocks.title: Chỉ đổ xăng ở trạm BB bằng thẻ AA

chunks: by paying with an AA credit card.
I told my friends about this,
and they all go to BB gas station now.
items.en: I only get gas at BB gas station because I get a 5% discount by paying with an AA credit card. I told my friends about this, and they all go to BB gas station now.

blocks.title: Đã đổ nhầm xăng vào xe dầu diesel của bố

chunks: and was running out of gas.
if it was enough to get home.
I have never put gas in the car
regular gas in my dad’s car
items.en: I put regular gas in my car, but my dad puts diesel fuel in his car. I was driving around with my dad’s car yesterday and was running out of gas. I didn’t know if it was enough to get home. I have never put gas in the car before and I accidentally put regular gas in my dad’s car instead.

blocks.title: Đỗ xe ngược vì không biết bình xăng ở đâu

chunks: I just got my driver’s license
and drove my mom’s car around.
I went to the gas station
items.en: I just got my driver’s license and drove my mom’s car around. I went to the gas station for the first time. I didn’t know which side of the car the tank was on, and I pulled up on the wrong side. It was frustrating to switch sides at the busy gas station.

blocks.title: Xe chết máy nên phải mua xăng mang về

chunks: and I was on a highway.
The low gas signal came up
my car ran out of gas
and put it in my car
items.en: I was on my way to my grandma’s and I was on a highway. The low gas signal came up but I thought I had enough to get to her house. About 30 minutes later, my car ran out of gas and stopped. I had to run to the nearest gas station, buy gas, and put it in my car myself.
notes: đang đi trên đường cao tốc

blocks.title: Rửa xe ở khu rửa xe tự động của trạm xăng

chunks: I usually pick the auto car wash.
and then it dries the car.
items.en: When my car needs cleaning, I face a straight choice between cost and effort. I usually pick the auto car wash. It costs 5,000 won for a regular wash which includes wheels and hubs, and then it dries the car.
notes: face a straight choice between A and B
đối mặt với việc phải chọn giữa hai thứ

blocks.title: Ghé trạm dừng nghỉ cũng đổ luôn xăng

chunks: my family went on a trip
to the southern part of the country.
We also put gas in the car
every time we were at a rest area
items.en: Last month, my family went on a trip to the southern part of the country. We took the highway and stopped at rest areas three times. We also put gas in the car every time we were at a rest area because you never know when you will come across the next gas station.
notes: go on a trip to A

blocks.title: Khó tìm trạm nạp LPG

chunks: to find LPG stations in the city.
I once got in a car accident
When the low gas signal came up,
I had to go all the way
to the eastern part of the city.
items.en: It is hard to find LPG stations in the city. I once got in a car accident and my insurance company lent me an LPG-fueled vehicle. When the low gas signal came up, I had to go all the way to the eastern part of the city.

blocks.title: Mẹ nấu ăn, bố rửa bát

chunks: he wanted to help my mom
that we couldn’t eat it at all.
my dad does the dishes afterwards.
items.en: After my dad retired, he wanted to help my mom with the housework. He tried to cook but it was so bad that we couldn’t eat it at all. My mom told him to do the dishes instead. When my mom cooks, my dad does the dishes afterwards.

blocks.title: Đã dọn phòng khách và nhà vệ sinh

chunks: My mom went on a trip
both the living room and the bathroom.
items.en: My mom went on a trip with her friends. I wanted to impress her while she was gone. I decided to clean both the living room and the bathroom. It was not easy to clean the toilet but I felt good once I finished it.

blocks.title: Hút bụi thảm

chunks: but technically it was my turn
I didn’t want to do it
items.en: The carpet didn’t look dirty but technically it was my turn to vacuum. I didn’t want to do it but I did it anyway. After cleaning it, I realized how dirty it was. I think I should do it on a regular basis.
notes: về nguyên tắc, xét theo lý thuyết

blocks.title: Lau sàn bằng giẻ

chunks: We were having a great dinner
When my grandma tried to stand up
she spilled the soup in front of her
items.en: It was my grandma’s birthday. We were having a great dinner at our house. When my grandma tried to stand up to go to the bathroom, she spilled the soup in front of her on the floor. I had to get up and mop the floor.

blocks.title: Mở cửa thông gió sau khi nấu ăn

chunks: I opened every window in the house
items.en: My mom decided to make steak and seafood pasta for my grandma’s birthday. She cooked for two hours and the house was filled with the smell of seafood. I opened every window in the house and let the air out.
notes: cho không khí thoát ra, thông gió

blocks.title: Ghét việc đổ rác thức ăn

chunks: to throw away the food waste.
I went out to throw it away
when I got to the trash bin
I threw it from a distance
items.en: I don’t like to throw away the food waste. It smells so bad. Last night I went out to throw it away and the smell got worse when I got to the trash bin for the food waste. I threw it from a distance and ran.

blocks.title: Nước Mỹ không phân loại rác đúng cách

chunks: We separate our trash at home.
when I went to the States,
items.en: We separate our trash at home. However, when I went to the States, I was surprised to see that not many people were using recycling bins. I think it is important to separate trash.

blocks.title: Giặt máy rồi phơi quần áo

chunks: I decided to do the laundry.
items.en: The weather was really nice on Saturday. I decided to do the laundry. I put all the clothes in a washing machine. It took an hour to wash them. After that, I put all the clothes on the drying rack. I felt good.

blocks.title: Lau bàn ăn và bày đũa thìa

chunks: put the spoons and chopsticks on.
I once forgot to wipe the table
and saw my dad dropping his food
items.en: My mom tells me to wipe the table first and then put the spoons and chopsticks on. I once forgot to wipe the table and saw my dad dropping his food on the table, grabbing it and putting it back in his mouth. I felt bad and since then, I always wipe the table.

blocks.title: Bạn tôi kiểm tra khu hút thuốc ở quán cà phê

chunks: My friend Lee is a heavy smoker.
So whenever we go to a coffee shop,
items.en: My friend Lee is a heavy smoker. So whenever we go to a coffee shop, she always makes sure it has a smoking area inside. She never goes to one without one.

blocks.title: Được tặng bánh quy miễn phí vì đơn hàng bị chậm

chunks: I went to the coffee shop
I went up to the counter
and gave me a free cookie.
items.en: I went to the coffee shop in front of my office this morning. I ordered and waited but my buzzer never rang. I waited for more than 10 minutes. I went up to the counter and asked what was happening. They apologized and gave me a free cookie.

blocks.title: Chọn một trong ba loại americano, latte, macchiato

chunks: Whenever I go to a coffee shop,
items.en: Whenever I go to a coffee shop, I choose between an Americano, latte, and macchiato. It depends on my mood. Today, I felt down so I had a latte with extra caramel syrup.

blocks.title: Tiền cà phê cũng ngang tiền ăn trưa

chunks: the lunch that I usually eat
and a Starbucks latte also costs 5,000 won.
items.en: I always drink coffee after lunch. It’s like a habit. The thing is, the lunch that I usually eat costs 5,000 won and a Starbucks latte also costs 5,000 won. So I am seriously thinking of quitting coffee.

blocks.title: Đồ uống ra khác với đã gọi

chunks: to get him a soy latte.
I ordered the soy latte to go
When I gave it to my boss,
They gave me the wrong drink.
to get him a soy latte.
items.en: My boss told me to get him a soy latte. I ordered the soy latte to go and left the cafe. When I gave it to my boss, he said it wasn’t the soy latte. They gave me the wrong drink. I got yelled at and went back to get him a soy latte.

blocks.title: Đã ghép hai bàn lại để ngồi

chunks: I went to a coffee shop
one of my friends called me,
to come to the coffee shop.
The table was not big enough,
so we had to put two tables together.
items.en: I went to a coffee shop with two other friends. We were chatting for a really long time. A few hours later, one of my friends called me, and I told him to come to the coffee shop. The table was not big enough, so we had to put two tables together.

blocks.title: Không gọi được đồ uống đá vì thiếu 500 won

chunks: I wanted to drink an Americano
so I went to the local coffee shop
and I ordered an iced Americano.
I had to order a hot Americano
items.en: I wanted to drink an Americano so I went to the local coffee shop in my area. I only had 2,000 won and I ordered an iced Americano. They said an iced Americano was 2,500 won. I had to order a hot Americano and let it sit for 10 minutes.

blocks.title: Thất vọng vì giá cà phê ở quán bình thường

chunks: There is a brand-new coffee shop
It wasn’t a big franchise shop
items.en: There is a brand-new coffee shop in front of my office. It wasn’t a big franchise shop like Starbucks, so I thought their coffee would be cheap. However, a latte was over 4,000 won. I was so disappointed.

blocks.title: Ống hút, siro và khăn giấy để chung một chỗ

chunks: I was at a coffee shop
I went up to the counter
Straws, syrup and napkins were placed
items.en: I was at a coffee shop with my friend the other day. We ordered our drinks and while my friend went to get our drinks, I tried to get some straws and some napkins. I went up to the counter but couldn’t find them. Straws, syrup and napkins were placed all together next to a trash bin.

blocks.title: Mất 40 phút để bắt được taxi

chunks: so there were so many people
and everyone was trying to get cabs.
items.en: I left the office at midnight. However, it was Friday so there were so many people on the street and everyone was trying to get cabs. It took me 40 minutes to get a cab.

blocks.title: Taxi mãi không tới

chunks: and there were no cabs around.
I tried to call a cab
items.en: The weather was freezing cold and there were no cabs around. I tried to call a cab but they said no cab was available at that moment. I just walked home.
notes: có sẵn, có thể dùng được

blocks.title: Bị tính phụ phí vì là giờ khuya

chunks: but since it was 2 in the morning,
I had to pay an extra charge.
when the weather is bad outside.
items.en: I could have walked home but it was too cold. I caught a cab but since it was 2 in the morning, I had to pay an extra charge. I should just stay home when the weather is bad outside.

blocks.title: Đã xuống xe không nói gì khi bị từ chối chở

chunks: When I told the taxi driver my destination,
to let me get in his cab.
there are so many crazy people
that I don’t want to make any trouble.
items.en: When I told the taxi driver my destination, he refused to let me get in his cab. I was upset, but did not say anything and got out. I did it because recently there are so many crazy people that I don’t want to make any trouble.

blocks.title: Tài xế taxi đã đi đường vòng

chunks: I was familiar with the route
items.en: I was familiar with the route that I was heading to. However, the cab driver took a longer way around. He almost charged me double the usual fare. It was unfair.
notes: gấp đôi giá cước thông thường

blocks.title: Đi taxi mà lại mất thời gian hơn

chunks: that taking a cab would be faster
because it doesn’t make any stops.
and it ended up taking longer than usual.
items.en: I woke up late this morning so I took a cab. I thought that taking a cab would be faster than the bus because it doesn’t make any stops. However, the traffic was horrible during rush hour and it ended up taking longer than usual.

blocks.title: Tuy đắt nhưng ban đêm đi taxi cao cấp

chunks: I don’t usually take a deluxe taxi
when I take a cab at night,
because they drive up to my house.
items.en: I don’t usually take a deluxe taxi because they are too expensive. However, when I take a cab at night, I usually use deluxe cabs because they drive up to my house.
notes: lái xe đến tận đâu đó

blocks.title: Tài xế taxi nói quá nhiều

chunks: I got in a cab this morning.
I stayed up late last night
the cab driver would not stop talking.
I didn’t want to be rude
items.en: I got in a cab this morning. I stayed up late last night so I was very tired. However, the cab driver would not stop talking. I didn’t want to be rude but it was frustrating.

blocks.title: Tài xế taxi không nhận khách đi quãng đường ngắn

chunks: that I decided to take a cab.
When I told the driver my destination,
so I didn’t take the change
items.en: The weather was so hot that I decided to take a cab. When I told the driver my destination, he said he doesn’t usually take passengers for short-distance rides in the city. I felt bad so I didn’t take the change when getting out.
notes: hành khách đi quãng đường ngắn

blocks.title: Đã đi taxi tốc hành từ Gangnam đến Wonju

chunks: I went from Gangnam to Wonju
but I almost wet my pants.
I never want to get in a speeding taxi
items.en: I went from Gangnam to Wonju in a speeding taxi. It only took 40 minutes but I almost wet my pants. I never want to get in a speeding taxi ever again.

blocks.title: Đã đăng ký khóa học qua mạng

chunks: and found a Chinese language academy
I signed up for a class
items.en: I wanted to learn Chinese. So I looked online and found a Chinese language academy near Gangnam station. I signed up for a class by paying with my credit card.

blocks.title: Khóa học muốn học đã hết chỗ

chunks: if there was another class still open.
items.en: The basic Chinese class I wanted to take was already so full that I couldn’t sign up. I called the academy and asked if there was another class still open. But they said every class was full.

blocks.title: Học lớp lúc 7 giờ sáng

chunks: but it is definitely worth it.
items.en: I take a Japanese class at 7 in the morning. Since it is really early, there are not many people in the class and I like it. It is hard to wake up so early, but it is definitely worth it.

blocks.title: Nhận thẻ học viên và giáo trình vào ngày khai giảng

chunks: On the very first day of the class,
I went to the front desk
I put the card in my wallet
in order not to lose it.
items.en: On the very first day of the class, I went to the academy after work. I went to the front desk on the second floor and received the books and my class identification card. I put the card in my wallet in order not to lose it.
notes: on the very first day of A

blocks.title: Điểm TOEIC tăng nhiều sau khi học khóa luyện thi

chunks: I signed up for a TOEIC class.
My score before I signed up
I took the TOEIC test again
and my score went up to 810.
items.en: I signed up for a TOEIC class. My score before I signed up was 500 out of 990. I needed to score at least 800 on TOEIC to apply for a job, so I decided to study at an academy. Three months later, I took the TOEIC test again and my score went up to 810. I was so happy.

blocks.title: Cân nhắc nhiều điều khi đăng ký khóa học

chunks: When I sign up for class
I usually consider my friends’ opinions,
the academy itself and the instructors.
items.en: When I sign up for class at a language academy, I usually consider my friends’opinions, the academy itself and the instructors. It is important for the academy to have a good reputation so I often look online to see the reviews.

blocks.title: Học nhóm với bạn bè sau giờ học

chunks: I asked some of my classmates
for an extra hour after class.
items.en: I never study when I get home after class. I asked some of my classmates if they could study together after class, and they all wanted to. We always study together for an extra hour after class. I think it really helps.

blocks.title: Phí tiền vì không đi học đầy đủ

chunks: I signed up for this Japanese class
It was a waste of money.
items.en: I signed up for this Japanese class last month. Because of some overtime and get-togethers from my department, I only took three classes out of ten. It was a waste of money.
notes: buổi họp mặt (liên hoan công ty)

blocks.title: Lần đầu tiên học hết trọn khóa

chunks: I have been going to a Chinese academy
Even though I couldn’t attend regularly,
and tried my best to go.
I am so proud of myself.
items.en: I have been going to a Chinese academy for six months now. Even though I couldn’t attend regularly, I constantly signed up and tried my best to go. This month I was actually not absent a single day. I am so proud of myself.

blocks.title: Huấn luyện viên chỉnh sửa tư thế cho

chunks: I started to go to the gym
a trainer comes up to me
items.en: I started to go to the gym a month ago. I walk on a treadmill and lift weights. When I am working out, a trainer comes up to me and helps me to work out properly. It is very helpful to exercise correctly.

blocks.title: Thay đồ trong phòng tủ khóa

chunks: People change in a locker room.
items.en: People change in a locker room. I feel self-conscious in the locker room. So I change as quickly as possible, while not looking at anyone.
notes: hay để ý người khác nhìn mình, ngại ngùng

blocks.title: Mang giày thể thao riêng theo

items.en: I usually bring my workout sneakers to the gym. I once left my shoes in a locker room and I lost them. I was so upset but it was my fault so there was no one to blame it on.
notes: đổ lỗi cho ai đó về điều gì

blocks.title: Việc đầu tiên là chạy máy chạy bộ 30 phút

chunks: When I get to the gym,
I first run and then stretch
I don’t do the stationary bikes
items.en: When I get to the gym, the first exercise I do is running on the treadmill for half an hour. I first run and then stretch for another half an hour. It feels really good when I sweat after running. I don’t do the stationary bikes or the Step Master.
notes: đổ mồ hôi, ra mồ hôi

blocks.title: Chạy xong thì tập tạ 1 tiếng

chunks: When I am at the gym,
that lifting weights is very important,
so I try to do that
items.en: When I am at the gym, I first run for 30 minutes. After running, I lift weights for an hour. I heard that lifting weights is very important, so I try to do that as often as possible. It certainly is not fun, but I feel good after doing it.

blocks.title: Muốn được giảm giá phải thanh toán một lần

chunks: But if you join for six months,
But the discount is only offered
items.en: The gym membership costs 80,000 won per month. But if you join for six months, they give you a discount; it is 300,000 won for six months. But the discount is only offered when you pay it all at once.

blocks.title: Có thể tập gym, yoga và cả golf

chunks: You can also go to a golf shooting range
so I look up the schedule
items.en: My gym has many exercise machines and group exercise rooms for yoga and Pilates. You can also go to a golf shooting range in the basement. I like doing group exercises like yoga, so I look up the schedule beforehand and always go on time.

blocks.title: Có thể tập luyện đều đặn bất kể thời tiết

chunks: about working out at a gym
is that I can work out
no matter what weather is like.
if you like to jog in the park,
even when it rains or snows.
items.en: One of the best things about working out at a gym is that I can work out no matter what weather is like. I mean, if you like to jog in the park, you can’t do it when it rains. I go to the gym almost every day even when it rains or snows.

blocks.title: Tập 3 tháng đã giảm cân và có cơ bắp

chunks: I have been going to the gym
at least three times a week.
My friend decided to join the gym
items.en: I have been going to the gym for three months now. I have been working out at least three times a week. I lost weight and gained muscle. My friend decided to join the gym after she saw me. I felt good.

blocks.title: Ở nhà suốt 3 ngày nghỉ phép

chunks: I didn’t go on a vacation
It was the best vacation ever.
items.en: I didn’t go on a vacation this summer. I took three days off and just stayed home. I really needed this time. I woke up at 11 a.m. and watched TV for 10 hours. It was the best vacation ever.

blocks.title: Đã đi leo núi trong kỳ nghỉ

chunks: and it was just so refreshing.
to climb up to the top.
once I was on the top,
items.en: I went to a mountain for a vacation. The weather was so nice and it was just so refreshing. I don’t normally go hiking, so it was very hard to climb up to the top. However, once I was on the top, it felt great.

blocks.title: Đã đi biển cùng gia đình

chunks: My family went to the beach
I love going to the beach
and we had a great barbeque
items.en: My family went to the beach last weekend. I love going to the beach because I love swimming. My sister and I swam for 5 hours and we had a great barbeque in the evening. It was delicious.

blocks.title: Đã đi thăm điểm du lịch nổi tiếng ở Busan trong kỳ nghỉ

chunks: The last time we went on vacation,
in the very south of the country.
and found some amazing tourist places.
We went to three different locations
items.en: The last time we went on vacation, we went to Busan. The city is located in the very south of the country. They have great seafood there. I looked online and found some amazing tourist places. We went to three different locations and they were all fantastic.

blocks.title: Đã đi du lịch bằng xe đạp cùng bạn

chunks: to go on a bike trip.
toward the northern part of the country
We biked about 30 miles a day
and stayed at a bed and breakfast
It was one of the best trips
items.en: My friend and I decided to go on a bike trip. We biked toward the northern part of the country this summer. We biked about 30 miles a day and stayed at a bed and breakfast at night. It was one of the best trips in my life.

blocks.title: Đã đặt phòng khách sạn vì là mùa cao điểm

chunks: My family once went to the beach.
My mom made a hotel reservation
because it was the busy season.
When we got to the hotel,
that every room was booked already.
items.en: My family once went to the beach. My mom made a hotel reservation a month in advance because it was the busy season. When we got to the hotel, we could see that every room was booked already.
notes: đã được đặt trước, hết chỗ

blocks.title: Dự định đi nghỉ ở Thái Lan

chunks: I have never been there before,
A local guide will explain everything
items.en: I am planning on going on a vacation to Thailand. I have never been there before, so I am thinking of going on a tour through a travel agency. A local guide will explain everything and it will be safer than going alone.

blocks.title: Nghỉ ngơi tốt trong kỳ nghỉ nên đã được tiếp thêm năng lượng

chunks: I ate so much delicious food
and slept for 10 hours a day.
items.en: I really needed a vacation. I finally had one and went to Jeju Island for three days. It was so relaxing. I ate so much delicious food and slept for 10 hours a day. After such a great vacation, I felt totally refreshed.

blocks.title: Hết kỳ nghỉ lại càng mệt hơn

chunks: I am thinking of staying home
items.en: I usually go somewhere during my vacation because I don’t want to waste my time sitting at home. However, as I got older, I feel more exhausted once the vacation ends. I am thinking of staying home as of my next vacation.

days.title: Trò chơi điện tử
days.uses: Day 2 + Day 12

items.en: When I was in middle school, I used to be addicted to computer games.

chunks: I often stayed up all night
items.en: I often stayed up all night playing computer games.
At that time, I only thought about games.

chunks: My school grades were really bad
and I failed almost every test.
items.en: My school grades were really bad and I failed almost every test.
When I started high school, I decided to study hard.
I don’t play computer games anymore.
Recently, I started to play games on my smartphone.

chunks: My favorite smartphone game is called
items.en: My favorite smartphone game is called Candy Crush Saga.

chunks: when I am on the bus
items.en: I usually play it when I am on the bus or on the train.

chunks: I need to carry my smartphone charger around
because the battery dies so quickly.
items.en: I need to carry my smartphone charger around because the battery dies so quickly.

chunks: I played the game too often
items.en: Last month, I played the game too often and used too much data.
I ended up receiving an enormous bill this month.

script.en: When I was in middle school, I used to be addicted to computer games. I often stayed up all night playing computer games. At that time, I only thought about games. My school grades were really bad and I failed almost every test. When I started high school, I decided to study hard. I don’t play computer games anymore. Recently, I started to play games on my smartphone. My favorite smartphone game is called Candy Crush Saga. I usually play it when I am on the bus or on the train. I need to carry my smartphone charger around because the battery dies so quickly. Last month, I played the game too often and used too much data. I ended up receiving an enormous bill this month.

days.title: Mua sắm
days.uses: Day 11 + Day 31

chunks: I decided to spend less money.
items.en: After getting an enormous bill, I decided to spend less money.
I decided to do some window shopping at the mall.

chunks: I just wanted to walk around,
items.en: I just wanted to walk around, but the sales clerk asked if I needed any help.
I said no, but she kept following me.
It was annoying.

chunks: and walked out of the store.
items.en: I couldn’t stand it and walked out of the store.

chunks: so I couldn’t get free parking.
items.en: In addition, I had no receipt from my purchases, so I couldn’t get free parking.

chunks: I went to some street vendors.
items.en: I went to some street vendors.

chunks: I like shopping at street vendors
because I can get a cash discount.
items.en: I like shopping at street vendors because I can get a cash discount.

chunks: I only had a credit card,
so I went to an ATM
items.en: I only had a credit card, so I went to an ATM to withdraw some cash.

chunks: I only use my bank’s ATM
because they charge me a fee
items.en: I only use my bank’s ATM because they charge me a fee to use another bank’s ATM.
On my way back home, I took the subway.
I hardly buy things on the subway, but I bought this razor because it was cheap.
I was satisfied with it.

script.en: After getting an enormous bill, I decided to spend less money. I decided to do some window shopping at the mall. I just wanted to walk around, but the sales clerk asked if I needed any help. I said no, but she kept following me. It was annoying. I couldn’t stand it and walked out of the store. In addition, I had no receipt from my purchases, so I couldn’t get free parking. I went to some street vendors. I like shopping at street vendors because I can get a cash discount. I only had a credit card, so I went to an ATM to withdraw some cash. I only use my bank’s ATM because they charge me a fee to use another bank’s ATM. On my way back home, I took the subway. I hardly buy things on the subway, but I bought this razor because it was cheap. I was satisfied with it.

days.title: Một ngày cùng em trai
days.uses: Day 1 + Day 3 + Day 21

items.en: When I was five, my parents wanted to have a baby boy.
I now have two brothers.
It is always crowded in my house.
I gave my younger brother the razor I bought on the subway.
He liked it.
We went out to have a drink.

chunks: My brother drinks like a fish
items.en: My brother drinks like a fish and he drinks every other day.

chunks: after only a glass of beer.

items.en: We only had one bottle of soju together but my face turned red.

script.en: When I was five, my parents wanted to have a baby boy. I now have two brothers. It is always crowded in my house. I gave my younger brother the razor I bought on the subway. He liked it. We went out to have a drink. My brother drinks like a fish and he drinks every other day. On the other hand, I get drunk after only a glass of beer. I want to drink well but I just can’t. We only had one bottle of soju together but my face turned red. We went to the park to take a walk. In the park, we could see a garden, some statues, and a lake. There was a big playground at the park. It had slides, swings, and a jungle gym. We walked for about an hour and sat on a bench. My brother started to feed some birds. About two minutes later, a flock of birds came to where we were. I felt nervous so we left the park.

days.title: Ăn kiêng và máy bán hàng tự động
days.uses: Day 4 + Day 21 + Day 33

items.en: Last month, I went to the park almost every day.

chunks: so I ate small portions of food
and exercised at the park regularly.
items.en: I decided to lose weight so I ate small portions of food and exercised at the park regularly.

chunks: I started to run every day.
items.en: I started to run every day.

chunks: The park also has some exercise machines.
items.en: The park also has some exercise machines.
So I used the machines after running.
However, I love to eat late at night.
I ate late-night snacks quite often.

chunks: I failed to lose any weight.
items.en: I failed to lose any weight.
One day, after exercising, the weather was boiling hot and I was so thirsty.

chunks: and tried to get a cold soda.
items.en: I found a vending machine and tried to get a cold soda.

chunks: but the vending machine ate my coins.
items.en: I put some coins in, but the vending machine ate my coins.
I was upset and gave it a kick.
It spat out my coins.
The vending machine was out of Coke anyway.

items.en: There is a water purifier in my office, but I feel like bottled water is cleaner than water from the water purifier. So I just stop by a convenience store and buy one pack on my way to work. I like to buy bottled water at a convenience store because I get to have many options to choose from. Nowadays, I like to drink fruit or herb flavored mineral water. I think it is a refreshing and a healthier alternative to sugary sodas.

items.en: There are many different types of bottled water, such as vitamin water, diet water, and hangover water. I am not sure if they really work, but since they have different flavors and benefits, it makes me want to drink one whenever I feel like I need it. There is a convenience store right next to my office building so I always stop there to buy bottled water.

items.en: I prefer drinking bottled water because I don’t want to wash glasses every time I drink water. So I usually stop by a convenience store and get bottled water. However, it is true that bottled water can be quite pricey. I used to drink tap water to save money. Furthermore, the city said it was safe to drink tap water. However, it didn’t taste good. So I just started to drink bottled water again.

items.en: When you are at a coffee shop, it feels good because it is cool in the summer and warm in the winter. The chairs are comfortable to sit on so it is good to grab a drink and chat for a bit. I sometimes spend hours sitting in a coffee shop reading books or chatting with my friends. I think this is why people like to go to coffee shops and there are so many of them in the city.

However, there is strong competition among coffee shops and making a profit is never easy. People like going to new coffee shops but the problem is that new coffee shops are constantly opening.

Now we are getting older together and we are more like friends. We talk about everything like clothes, food, and boyfriends. I love talking to my sister. items.en: When I was young, I used to talk to my mom about everything. I would tell her about my friends, school life and just about anything. It was fun talking to her. However, as I got older, I kind of stopped talking to her. I don’t know why but I just don’t talk to her that much. Sometimes, I feel like she doesn’t understand me anymore. There is no time to sit down and have a conversation with my family members.

He gave me good advice on how to find a good job that would suit me. I would also often talk to my mom. She always gives me positive energy so talking to her always makes me feel good.

For example, there could be a car crash in a book, and you could just imagine one car crashing into another one, but, in a movie, you could see one car crash into another and blow up. This just looks and sounds more exciting. Special effects help the imagination grow.

items.en: I think determination and persistence are the keys to success. I don’t ever give up and keep going with staying power no matter how much I am tempted to just give up. The achievable goals in life are generally very well defined. I try to know exactly what I want and stick to it. I am also willing to go the extra mile to accomplish my goals.

items.en: The first thing to do when setting goals is to make them doable. I try to look at the paths of people I admire and find practical steps. For example, my role model is this famous pianist. She said in her interview that she has put in 14 hours of practice and training every day for dozens of years. I am not trying to be a pianist but I learned so much from her success. Whenever I want to give up, I think of her and try to do my best.

items.en: I write my goals down. I put them on a piece of paper or a note card and tape it to a place I look at every morning when I wake up and every night when I go to bed. I always believe I can do it because the minute I say, “I can’t. It’s over,” it really is over. At the same time, I never say “I could have done better.” I always think that my performance was the best I could have given.

items.en: I know eating small portions of food and exercising regularly are the most important to lose weight. The problem is that I have no motivation to exercise and I keep feeling like I want to eat and eat. I just can’t control my hunger and end up eating instant noodles late at night. I think I seriously need to give myself motivation to lose weight.

items.en: I think the reason why I can’t succeed in losing weight is because I am too hard on myself when I am on a diet. I like eating fast food and sweets but when I decide to lose weight, all of a sudden, I switch to a diet based on only fruit or vegetables and my body finds it difficult to adapt. I end up spoiling myself every once in a while throughout the diet by eating KFC chicken. I think if I want to really lose weight, the first thing I should do is quit eating fast food.

items.en: I once tried a vinegar diet. I drank a certain amount of vinegar every day. Needless to say, it didn’t work and I didn’t lose any weight. I wanted to lose weight in the short term and couldn’t think beyond getting those ten pounds off. I realized that if I want to lose weight and keep it off in the long term, I should eat a healthy diet that is sustainable for the rest of my life.

items.en: I think money is the most important thing in order to achieve your dreams. Without money, you can’t study what you want nor have the type of experiences you desire. You need money to go to a language center or to travel abroad, but many people give up because they can’t afford it. People who are better off financially are more likely to be able to do what they want to do, compared to people who are not. It is not always true but it seems that self-made people are becoming rare. You can have dreams and invest in your dreams only when you can afford to.

items.en: It is important to find out what type of occupation you really want. Many people don’t think about what they want and just try to fit in with society by getting a good job as defined by society. It is a serious problem in our country that a lot of people automatically choose their major, college, and even career based on what society says. I think it is very wrong. Whatever you can dream of, you can achieve. People should begin to live their dreams. This must be realized first.
