your biggest asset is your personal connections.
items.en: Networking with other people is very important. You need to be connected with people who can help you make your dreams come true. No matter how hardworking or intelligent you are, when you take on too many duties, you are limited. It is important to get help from people around you. Your abilities are confined and you need professional assistance in various fields in order to achieve your dreams. This could be the reason why a person who looks down on others and neglects others’ abilities is more likely to fail. When it comes to becoming a successful person, your biggest asset is your personal connections.

days.title: Bạn vượt qua khó khăn bằng cách nào?
days.titleEn: How do you get over a problem?

items.title: Nảy ra ý tưởng khi đọc sách
chunks: I tend to go to the bookstore
I search for books on the issue
I used to read a lot.
I think I get more imaginative
to think out of the box
items.en: When I have problems that I need help with, I tend to go to the bookstore in my neighborhood. I search for books on the issue and read. I used to read a lot. When I read a book, great ideas come to me. I think I get more imaginative from reading books. Therefore, I usually read books to think out of the box in order to solve problems.

items.title: Xin lời khuyên từ bạn bè
chunks: When I am in big trouble,
I usually talk to my friends.
What others say about my problem
but I can at least think broadly
items.en: When I am in big trouble, I usually talk to my friends. Sometimes, it is helpful to talk to others and get advice. What others say about my problem is not always right but I can at least think broadly and view my problem from a different perspective. It is also good to talk to my friends because chatting with them releases my stress as well.

items.title: Quên đi lo lắng bằng việc tập thể dục
chunks: When I am tired and stressed,
I get to forget about my worries
I’m also able to view my problems differently
items.en: I exercise. When I am tired and stressed, I tend to think negatively and view my problems from a narrow perspective. However, when I exercise, I get to forget about my worries and focus on my workout. I love running, playing basketball and so on. After I work out hard and sweat it off, I feel refreshed. I’m also able to view my problems differently and I feel positive.

days.title: Điều quan trọng nhất trong quản lý thời gian là gì?
days.titleEn: What is the most important thing to remember about time management?

items.title: Tập trung vào việc quan trọng
chunks: helps me get more done each day.
by managing my time more wisely,
and improve my quality of life.
I block out the time on my calendar
and turn off my phone and e-mail.
items.en: I know that managing my time effectively helps me get more done each day. Also, by managing my time more wisely, I can minimize stress and improve my quality of life. I block out the time on my calendar for big projects. During that time, I close my door and turn off my phone and e-mail.

items.title: Nâng cao khả năng tập trung bằng thói quen sống lành mạnh
chunks: it is important to have a healthy lifestyle.
I try to get plenty of sleep,
a healthy lifestyle can improve my concentration.
so that I can complete my work
items.en: I think it is important to have a healthy lifestyle. I try to get plenty of sleep, eat a healthy diet and exercise regularly. I think a healthy lifestyle can improve my concentration. It helps improve my efficiency so that I can complete my work in less time.

items.title: Đặt thứ tự ưu tiên và sử dụng thời gian tiết kiệm
chunks: and I spend my time and energy
that are truly important to me.
how to best spend my time.
that can be used more wisely.
I take a bus to work
items.en: I make a to-do list. I prioritize tasks and I spend my time and energy on those that are truly important to me. I also write down everything I will do for the following three days to determine how to best spend my time. I look for time that can be used more wisely. For example, I take a bus to work and use the commute to catch up on reading.

days.title: Khi nào lái xe lại bất tiện hơn?
days.titleEn: When is driving more inconvenient than taking public transportation?

items.title: Phải xuất phát sớm vì tắc đường
chunks: I started to drive a few years ago.
I got so tired of taking the subway to commute
so I decided to buy a car.
the rush hour traffic jam in the city
I just sleep an hour more
I don’t like to sit in my car
so it is better to get some extra sleep
items.en: I started to drive a few years ago. I got so tired of taking the subway to commute so I decided to buy a car. However, the rush hour traffic jam in the city is crazy. I used to leave home at 8 in the morning but now I leave at 7 because of the traffic. When I am really tired, I just sleep an hour more and take the subway. I don’t like to sit in my car during a traffic jam so it is better to get some extra sleep and just take the subway.

items.title: Phí đỗ xe và tiền xăng quá đắt
chunks: but I usually take my car
when I go downtown for dinner.
it is hard to find a parking lot.
Some restaurants provide valet parking services
but I have to pay for that as well.
so I don’t take my car that often.
items.en: I always take the bus to go to school but I usually take my car when I go downtown for dinner. However, when I go downtown, it is hard to find a parking lot. There are some, but they are very expensive. Some restaurants provide valet parking services but I have to pay for that as well. I am already going broke from the gas prices so I don’t take my car that often.

chunks: it takes a lot more time
to drive than to take the subway.
So I usually use public transportation
when I see the crowd at a subway station
I regret that I didn’t take my car.
When I am in a hurry,
and when I have enough time,
I tend to drive my own car.
items.en: When the roads are packed, it takes a lot more time to drive than to take the subway. So I usually use public transportation to get around. However, when I see the crowd at a subway station in the morning rush hour, I regret that I didn’t take my car. When I am in a hurry, I just take the subway and when I have enough time, I tend to drive my own car.

days.title: Bạn thích mùa hè hay mùa đông hơn?
days.titleEn: Do you prefer summer or winter?

items.title: Sinh vào mùa đông nên tôi thích mùa đông!
chunks: I like being able to rug up at night
listening to the winter rain outside.
I also love to curl up
when it is freezing cold outside.
My favorite sport is also a winter sport,
so it just makes me love winter
items.en: I am a winter baby so I love winter. I like being able to rug up at night and lie in bed listening to the winter rain outside. I also love to curl up on the couch with a good book when it is freezing cold outside. My favorite sport is also a winter sport, so it just makes me love winter even more.

chunks: You don’t have to worry about putting on many layers of clothes
you can just put on shorts and a tank top
items.en: I like summer because it is hot and full of fun and it has long days. You can go swimming and I love the beach. You don’t have to worry about putting on many layers of clothes and in the summer time, you can just put on shorts and a tank top with some flip flops. So I like summer a lot better than winter.

items.title: Ghế xe lạnh cóng vào mùa đông? Ôi không!
chunks: There is nothing worse than getting up
and scraping the ice off your car windows
then having to sit in your freezing car
most of my sick or personal days
because sometimes it is just too cold
items.en: I don’t like winter. There is nothing worse than getting up for work at 7 a.m. and scraping the ice off your car windows then having to sit in your freezing car and wait for it to warm up. I can’t stand that. As you can imagine, most of my sick or personal days are used in the winter because sometimes it is just too cold to leave the house.

days.title: Điều bạn quan tâm nhất khi chọn phim là gì?
days.titleEn: What is the most important factor to consider before choosing a movie?

items.title: Doanh thu phòng vé
chunks: I check the weekend box office first.
It tells how much movies earned
When the movie The Da Vinci Code came out,
I went to see the movie
and it was still doing okay.
and it knocked it off the top spot.
the movie did better than it should have
but not as good as the producers had hoped.
items.en: When I pick a movie, I check the weekend box office first. It tells how much movies earned over the weekend. When the movie The Da Vinci Code came out, it made more than $30 million in just the US alone in its opening weekend. I went to see the movie in the 4th week of release and it was still doing okay. However, X-Men 3 came out and it knocked it off the top spot. I think the movie did better than it should have but not as good as the producers had hoped.

items.title: Có đạo diễn hay diễn viên yêu thích tham gia hay không
chunks: When a new movie comes out,
I first check who made that movie
I have some favorite movie directors,
When my favorite actor stars in the movie
or my favorite director makes the movie,
items.en: When a new movie comes out, I first check who made that movie and who is in it. I have some favorite movie directors, actors and actresses. When my favorite actor stars in the movie or my favorite director makes the movie, I go see it regardless of its reviews or box office rank.

items.title: Đôi khi là bài đánh giá phim
chunks: I have watched my favorite action movies
When a new action movie comes out,
I went to see a movie
items.en: I love watching action movies. I have watched my favorite action movies over and over again. When a new action movie comes out, I go see it. I sometimes pick a movie that has great reviews. Last weekend, I went to see a movie which had good reviews but it was very disappointing. I will not pick movies by reviews anymore.

days.title: Khi nào bạn thất vọng về người khác?
days.titleEn: When do you get disappointed in other people?

items.title: Khi họ làm việc mà tôi sẽ không bao giờ làm
chunks: we would do those exact same things for them.
When my best friend lied to me,
I was so disappointed in her.
I would never lie to her.
and we are not friends anymore.
items.en: I think sometimes we just get disappointed at our loved ones because we expect so much from them. Not because we are demanding, but because we know we would do those exact same things for them. When my best friend lied to me, I was so disappointed in her. I mean, I would never lie to her. She broke my heart and we are not friends anymore.

items.title: Khi thiếu chân thành và giả tạo
chunks: The thing that gets me upset
is that they still try to keep in contact with me,
and act like I have not realized
that they showed their true nature!
so I will keep trusting them.
items.en: I am a person who loves and trusts everybody, so it is easy to get very hurt when I find out that they were frauds. The thing that gets me upset is that they still try to keep in contact with me, and act like I have not realized that they showed their true nature! But I love people so I will keep trusting them.

items.title: Khi chỉ đối xử như bạn bè lúc cần
chunks: I was always there for her
when she needed a shoulder to cry on.
she would come up with the lamest excuses
not to get together with us.
and I decided to write her off.
items.en: This question reminds me of one of my friends from high school. I was always there for her when she needed a shoulder to cry on. She was a good friend when it suited her. However, she would come up with the lamest excuses not to get together with us. She lied frequently and I decided to write her off.

days.title: Thói quen tốt nào của bạn muốn khoe?
days.titleEn: What are your good habits that you want to boast about?

items.title: Cố gắng ăn uống lành mạnh
chunks: I have been working on eating healthier.
I am not fully there yet,
because I don’t want to give up on the yummy foods
that it takes about three or four months
to get a new habit to stick
as long as you keep making an effort
anytime you deviate from your plan.
items.en: I have been working on eating healthier. I am not fully there yet, because I don’t want to give up on the yummy foods that are out there. I read somewhere that it takes about three or four months to get a new habit to stick as long as you keep making an effort to get back on track anytime you deviate from your plan.

items.title: Dậy sớm vào buổi sáng
chunks: my parents literally dragged me out of bed
I had to adapt my body clock
to waking up at a particular time.
because I was a late riser
now I have a regular bed time
items.en: When I was a student, my parents literally dragged me out of bed every morning. After I started to work, I had to adapt my body clock to waking up at a particular time. At first, it was really hard because I was a late riser all my life. However, now I have a regular bed time and I feel comfortable waking up early.

items.title: Ghi chú mọi thứ
chunks: house chores I want to tackle,
blog posts I want to write,
that I have so many things to remember
that if I write them down,
my brain is instantly free to stop thinking about it,
items.en: I write everything down. I write down my to-do’s, my grocery lists, house chores I want to tackle, blog posts I want to write, goals I want to reach, dates I need to remember, etc. It’s not that I’m forgetful. It’s just that I have so many things to remember on a daily basis that if I write them down, my brain is instantly free to stop thinking about it, which means I can move on to bigger and better things.

days.title: Nhược điểm của mua sắm trực tuyến là gì?
days.titleEn: What are the negatives of online shopping?

items.title: Không thể thấy hàng thật cho đến khi nhận
chunks: the biggest weakness of online shopping
is that I don’t get to see the product
that it will look good on you
and the color and size could be different
from what you saw on the Internet.
I don’t buy things online anymore.
items.en: I think the biggest weakness of online shopping is that I don’t get to see the product until receiving it. Since you can’t see it, you are not sure that it will look good on you and the color and size could be different from what you saw on the Internet. I was disappointed several times and now, I don’t buy things online anymore.

items.title: Hàng thật có thể khác với những gì thấy trên màn hình
chunks: from what I saw on the screen.
they may not look good on me.
I like online shopping for things
but if I want to buy clothes or shoes,
I make sure to go to the shop
I will get all of details,
items.en: The product could be different from what I saw on the screen. If I am buying clothes, they may not look good on me. Therefore, I like online shopping for things but if I want to buy clothes or shoes, I make sure to go to the shop and try them on. If I like it, I will get all of details, write them down, go back to my house and order it online for a cheaper price.

items.title: Có nguy cơ rò rỉ thông tin và giao hàng mất thời gian
chunks: When I have to buy something,
that it is a good website
I don’t get the product right away.
It takes at least a couple of days to get it
I have to wait longer to get it
items.en: I don’t like online shopping because I don’t feel safe buying something online. When I have to buy something, I make sure that it is a good website and there are no leaks on the website. Also, I don’t get the product right away. It takes at least a couple of days to get it and sometimes over a week. I have to wait longer to get it unless I pay more.

days.title: Điện thoại thông minh gây hại gì cho chúng ta?
days.titleEn: What are the disadvantages of using smartphones?

items.title: Lãng phí vài tiếng đồng hồ vì mạng xã hội
chunks: I often find myself checking Facebook
when I plan on quickly checking updates
and wind up perusing people’s photos and status.
that I intend to spend hours of my day
but one thing leads to another
an hour or two has gone by.
items.en: I often find myself checking Facebook several times a day. Even worse is when I plan on quickly checking updates and wind up perusing people’s photos and status. It’s not that I intend to spend hours of my day on social networking sites, but one thing leads to another and before I realize, an hour or two has gone by.

items.title: Không chịu được việc chờ đợi dù chỉ một chút
chunks: I get so impatient when waiting.
I can’t even wait for 30 seconds
we are so used to getting everything
that when we have to wait a little bit,
items.en: I think I get so impatient when waiting. I can’t even wait for 30 seconds to download a video clip. I think we are so used to getting everything that we want instantaneously that when we have to wait a little bit, we get irritated.

items.title: Mắt bị mỏi vì điện thoại thông minh
chunks: Since smartphones have such a small screen,
I tend to hold my phone too close to my eyes.
So I try to rest my eyes
or watch videos on my phone.
items.en: Since smartphones have such a small screen, I tend to hold my phone too close to my eyes. Staring at my smartphone for about 30 minutes causes my eyes to strain. So I try to rest my eyes every 10 minutes when I read cartoons or watch videos on my phone. I recently experienced dry eye so I use eye drops and try to blink as often as I can.

days.title: Khi nào bạn thực sự muốn bỏ rượu?
days.titleEn: When do you really want to quit drinking?

items.title: Khi đã quá chán với các buổi nhậu ở công ty
chunks: and I liked them at first.
and don’t want to drink anymore.
I used to work at a place
where people never had drinking parties.
I am not used to this
and I just want to quit drinking
and stop going to those drinking parties.
items.en: I started my new job three months ago. We had many drinking parties and I liked them at first. But as time goes by, I feel tired and don’t want to drink anymore. Before I came here, I used to work at a place where people never had drinking parties. I am not used to this and I just want to quit drinking and stop going to those drinking parties.

items.title: Khi say đến mức mất trí nhớ
chunks: I went to my high school reunion party.
since I saw most of my former classmates
and I was very excited about it.
and we started to talk and drank
When the party was almost over,
everyone was getting ready to leave
but I was lying on the floor drunk.
items.en: Last weekend, I went to my high school reunion party. It has been almost 10 years since I saw most of my former classmates and I was very excited about it. My high school sweetheart came and we started to talk and drank for more than five hours. When the party was almost over, everyone was getting ready to leave but I was lying on the floor drunk. I literally don’t remember anything. The next morning, I decided to quit drinking.

items.title: Bố đã bỏ rượu sau khi bị chẩn đoán gan nhiễm mỡ
chunks: My dad used to drink like a fish.
and they often fought about it.
During one of my dad’s regular health checkups,
my dad had developed fat in his liver.
Fatty liver is not in itself a massive problem
then the chances of developing a more serious liver disease
items.en: My dad used to drink like a fish. My mom hated it and they often fought about it. During one of my dad’s regular health checkups, the doctor said my dad had developed fat in his liver. Fatty liver is not in itself a massive problem but if he kept drinking, then the chances of developing a more serious liver disease would go up. My dad stopped drinking after the checkup.

days.title: Xem phim ở nhà có lợi ích gì?
days.titleEn: What are the good things about watching movies at home?

items.title: Có thể xem với tư thế thoải mái
chunks: I love watching movies at home
so I can get up and go to the kitchen
rather than paying for overpriced food
if you miss an important part
while you’re getting food in the kitchen,
then you can go rewind it
and see the part you missed.
Or before you go to the kitchen,
items.en: I love watching movies at home because I can sprawl out on my couch. I think movie theater seats are very uncomfortable and confined. I also love eating so I can get up and go to the kitchen and go grab whatever I want, rather than paying for overpriced food at a cinema. Plus, if you miss an important part while you’re getting food in the kitchen, then you can go rewind it and see the part you missed. Or before you go to the kitchen, you can pause the movie and when you come back, you can resume the movie.

items.title: Có thể xem bất cứ khi nào muốn
chunks: I also enjoy buying a DVD movie
and a nice big bowl of popcorn,
and watching a movie at night.
items.en: I also enjoy buying a DVD movie in order to watch it whenever I want. Personally, I believe there is nothing better than spreading yourself out on a couch with a loved one and a nice big bowl of popcorn, and watching a movie at night. It seems so relaxing.

items.title: Có thể tự do chọn phim và thời gian chiếu
chunks: I love watching movies at home.
when I want to watch it,
with whom I want to watch it
I have a 42 inch LCD TV
or lying in my bed with pillows.
going to the dirty and crowded theaters
items.en: I love watching movies at home. It is more private and I can choose what I want to watch, when I want to watch it, with whom I want to watch it and so on. Plus, I can pause, rewind, or skip any section. I have a 42 inch LCD TV and a home theater so it is comfortable sitting in my sofa or lying in my bed with pillows. I don’t need to bother going to the dirty and crowded theaters with uncomfortable seats.

days.title: Khi rất mệt mỏi bạn làm gì?
days.titleEn: What do you do when you are exhausted?

items.title: Uống đồ uống chứa caffeine
chunks: but only for half an hour.
That immediate caffeine buzz wakes me up
when I need caffeine to function,
rather than knocking back a double shot espresso.
I also try to space out
a few mugs of weak tea or weaker coffee
so that I don’t get high and low mood swings.
items.en: When I am really tired, I drink some caffeinated beverages. I think caffeine definitely works but only for half an hour. That immediate caffeine buzz wakes me up and makes me think that I am fine. However, when I need caffeine to function, I take it in gradually rather than knocking back a double shot espresso. I also try to space out a few mugs of weak tea or weaker coffee so that I don’t get high and low mood swings.

items.title: Ngủ trưa một chút
chunks: I try to take a twenty to thirty minute nap.
because I would find myself awake
a nap can really restore me
items.en: When I feel exhausted, I try to take a twenty to thirty minute nap. I don’t take it longer because I would find myself awake feeling even more groggy than I did before. I think a nap can really restore me and get me going again. When it is not easy to take a nap because of my boss, I use my lunch hour or a scheduled break to nap.

items.title: Đi dạo một lát
chunks: from staring at a computer screen,
I try to do some exercise.
I can feel the tiredness fading.
and I don’t have to go to the gym
I take a five to ten minute break
items.en: When my eyes are tired from staring at a computer screen, I try to do some exercise. When I do it, I can feel the tiredness fading. Frequent short walks help me stay awake and I don’t have to go to the gym for an intense workout. I take a five to ten minute break to walk around once an hour.

days.title: Tập thể dục hay ăn ít hiệu quả hơn khi giảm cân?
days.titleEn: What do you think is a more effective way to lose weight, exercising or eating less?

items.title: Ăn ít mới là điều quan trọng nhất
chunks: eating less is the most important key
I used to eat out at restaurants
up to nine times a week.
By cutting back to just once a week
and ordering a grilled chicken salad
instead of a large bowl of pasta,
I lost 20 pounds in one month.
I still try to eat less
items.en: I think eating less is the most important key to diet success. I used to eat out at restaurants up to nine times a week. By cutting back to just once a week and ordering a grilled chicken salad instead of a large bowl of pasta, I lost 20 pounds in one month. I still try to eat less and watch what I eat.

items.title: Phải ăn sáng đầy đủ và ăn vặt ít hơn
chunks: I try to have a healthy diet.
but now I never go without it.
of a healthy mix of protein and whole grains.
so I snack less throughout the day.
In a little over a year,
items.en: I try to have a healthy diet. I used to skip breakfast, but now I never go without it. I always eat about 300 calories of a healthy mix of protein and whole grains. My go-to meal is a sandwich with natural peanut butter and apple butter. It keeps my hunger down so I snack less throughout the day. In a little over a year, I lost 65 pounds.

items.title: Phải đi bộ và chạy bộ
chunks: When I wanted to wear my skinny jeans again,
and it was usually deep-fried chicken pieces.
Instead of hanging around at night,
items.en: When I wanted to wear my skinny jeans again, I started running for 20 minutes during my lunch hour. I always grabbed dinner with my colleagues after work and it was usually deep-fried chicken pieces. Then I changed things up. Instead of hanging around at night, I started walking and running around my neighborhood. A year later, I lost 40 pounds.

days.title: Cách giải quyết sau khi cãi nhau với người thân là gì?
days.titleEn: How do you solve a fight with your best friend?

items.title: Viết mẩu giấy xin lỗi
chunks: When I have a fight with someone,
I try to say that I am sorry,
but it is often hard to do so.
I tend to write an apology note.
can be the best way to go,
but sometimes a note can also be meaningful.
because I am a bit shy
and I don’t really appreciate confrontation.
items.en: When I have a fight with someone, I try to say that I am sorry, but it is often hard to do so. Instead, I tend to write an apology note. I think saying I am sorry directly can be the best way to go, but sometimes a note can also be meaningful. This works well because I am a bit shy and I don’t really appreciate confrontation.

items.title: Dành thời gian giữ khoảng cách
chunks: when I have a major blowout
I get to see the situation
from a more objective point of view
and then I realize what I did wrong.
It takes me a day or two
I don’t let it go much longer than that
because too much time would actually make the problem or argument worse.
So I usually give the person
and give myself some time and space.
items.en: The first thing I do when I have a major blowout is just get some space. Then, I get to see the situation from a more objective point of view and then I realize what I did wrong. It takes me a day or two to do so. I don’t let it go much longer than that because too much time would actually make the problem or argument worse. So I usually give the person time to think and give myself some time and space.

items.title: Lắng nghe đối phương đến cùng
chunks: I try to listen to what my friend says first
and then I bring up my own points and feelings.
when I hear my friend out,
I don’t even need to express my feelings
puts a new spin on our argument
and I don’t feel the need
items.en: I try to listen to what my friend says first and then I bring up my own points and feelings. Sometimes, when I hear my friend out, I don’t even need to express my feelings because just viewing things from a different perspective puts a new spin on our argument and I don’t feel the need to tell my side.

days.title: Mối tương quan giữa tiền bạc và hạnh phúc là gì?
days.titleEn: What do you think is the correlation between money and happiness?

items.title: Hạnh phúc không thể mua bằng tiền
chunks: but when it comes down to it,
don’t equal up to the things
You can’t buy love or friends.
items.en: I think money could make you happy to an extent, such as buying clothes, cars, jewelry, and things that you want, but when it comes down to it, the things you want don’t equal up to the things you actually need, such as love and friendship. You can’t buy love or friends. So I think money cannot buy happiness.

items.title: Chỉ cần đủ tiền để giải quyết cuộc sống hằng ngày
chunks: but it sure can relieve stress.
and now worry about losing my car and apartment,
if I had some money now.
I don’t need to be very rich.
is to be able to pay my bills
and have a little fun sometimes.
people with a lot of money
items.en: I don’t think money can buy happiness but it sure can relieve stress. I was laid off and now worry about losing my car and apartment, so I would be happier if I had some money now. However, I don’t need to be very rich. All I want is to be able to pay my bills and have a little fun sometimes. I know people with a lot of money and they are not happier than I am, so I don’t necessarily think money can buy happiness.

items.title: Có thể mua hạnh phúc bằng tiền
chunks: when you cannot solve money problems.
if money can buy you freedom,
then it can buy you happiness.
items.en: I think money can buy happiness. You are not happy when you cannot solve money problems. Money helps you solve problems. Money also gives you freedom. You don’t have to work for 40 years in a cubicle. I think being free to do what I want when I want would make me happy. Therefore, if money can buy you freedom, then it can buy you happiness.

days.title: Vì sao mọi người đổ xô đến các quán cà phê chuỗi?
days.titleEn: Why are franchise coffee shops always crowded?

items.title: Vì có thể uống cà phê cao cấp
chunks: When you go to a coffee shop,
you can have high quality coffee.
like Starbucks and The Coffee Bean and Tea Leaf
and have a rich, floral aroma and smooth flavor.
Some people just love the taste of high quality coffee
and pay a lot for it.
items.en: When you go to a coffee shop, you can have high quality coffee. Most coffee shop franchises like Starbucks and The Coffee Bean and Tea Leaf purchase coffee from Colombia or other countries like Brazil, Costa Rica and Guatemala. Certainly those coffees taste different from instant coffee. Plus, they are usually organic and have a rich, floral aroma and smooth flavor. Some people just love the taste of high quality coffee and pay a lot for it.

items.title: Vì mỗi chuỗi bán loại cà phê đặc trưng riêng
chunks: Each coffee shop franchise uses different coffee beans
Starbucks has been purchasing coffee beans
They would not go somewhere else
like The Coffee Bean and Tea Leaf
The difference between coffee shop franchises
attracts people to come to their shops.
items.en: Each coffee shop franchise uses different coffee beans to brew their signature coffee. For example, Starbucks has been purchasing coffee beans from Colombian growers for more than 40 years now. People who like Starbucks coffee only go to Starbucks. They would not go somewhere else like The Coffee Bean and Tea Leaf unless they have no options. The difference between coffee shop franchises attracts people to come to their shops.

items.title: Vì có thể ngồi thoải mái
chunks: but a lot of people go to Starbucks,
When you pay 4,000 won for the small coffee,
you are not only paying for the coffee itself
but also paying for the place
and the chair you are sitting in.
Coffee shops are usually cool in the summer
so you can think of the coffee cost
as an electric bill as well.
items.en: A small Starbucks Americano usually costs about 4,000 won in Korea. It can be pricey but a lot of people go to Starbucks, order coffee and sit there. When you pay 4,000 won for the small coffee, you are not only paying for the coffee itself but also paying for the place and the chair you are sitting in. Coffee shops are usually cool in the summer and warm in the winter so you can think of the coffee cost as an electric bill as well.

days.title: Bạn làm gì để tiết kiệm tiền?
days.titleEn: What do you do to save money?

items.title: Mang theo cơm hộp tự chuẩn bị
chunks: I try not to eat out.
I usually prepare my food at home
the night before I go to school
I also use an empty water bottle
to fill with clean water from my house,
and I have saved a lot of money.
items.en: I try not to eat out. I usually prepare my food at home the night before I go to school and I just take it plus some fruit with me. I also use an empty water bottle to fill with clean water from my house, refrigerate it and take it to school. I have been doing this for over a year and I have saved a lot of money.

items.title: Lên thực đơn để giải quyết hai bữa cùng lúc
chunks: Those bills for eating out at lunch
I decided to make meal plans
and get comfortable with some easy recipes
that I can turn into two meals
items.en: Those bills for eating out at lunch every day or going out for dinner on the weekends add up quickly. I decided to make meal plans for the week ahead, buy the necessary ingredients at the grocery store, and get comfortable with some easy recipes that I can turn into two meals like dinner and the leftovers for lunch. It really worked.

items.title: Rút phích cắm điện không dùng đến
chunks: When the computer is connected by a power cord,
keeping my computer’s energy settings on power saver
items.en: I try to save energy in order to save money. When the computer is connected by a power cord, I turn it off for the night when I am done and unplug anything else I am not using. I think keeping my computer’s energy settings on power saver is another way to keep from wasting energy.

days.title: Khi nào trong ngày bạn lãng phí thời gian nhiều nhất?
days.titleEn: When do you most waste your time?

items.title: 30 phút đi làm mà chẳng làm được gì
chunks: is when I waste the most time
I need to be at the office
and take a bus to work.
but since it is rush hour,
so I can’t even read a book
I just hold onto the overhead strap
items.en: I think commuting during rush hour is when I waste the most time during the day. I need to be at the office before 9 in the morning. I leave my house at 8 and take a bus to work. It usually takes 20 minutes to get to work, but since it is rush hour, I have to leave home an hour ahead. The bus is usually packed so I can’t even read a book or do anything. I just hold onto the overhead strap and stand for 30 minutes doing nothing.

items.title: Hai tiếng nghịch điện thoại
chunks: of constantly updating my social media status.
at least three times a day.
what I am eating for lunch.
but I can’t stop playing with my phone.
I literally waste about two hours a day
items.en: I have a habit of constantly updating my social media status. I am always checking emails, playing games, chatting with friends etc. on my phone. I usually update my status and upload pictures at least three times a day. My colleague told me to get off the phone and he said no one needs to know what I am eating for lunch. I was shocked but I can’t stop playing with my phone. I think I literally waste about two hours a day playing with my phone.

items.title: 30 phút mất vào việc chọn quần áo
chunks: that I have so many amazing wardrobe choices
in the city I live in.
So I always have to think carefully about
which clothes and shoes I have to wear.
It usually takes about 30 minutes to decide
and I am often late for school.
items.en: It takes a long time for me to get dressed each day. This does not mean that I have so many amazing wardrobe choices to pick from. I only have a few but I just can’t decide what to wear. Especially in the summer, it rains quite often in the city I live in. So I always have to think carefully about which clothes and shoes I have to wear. It usually takes about 30 minutes to decide and I am often late for school.

days.title: Điều bạn luôn giữ để khỏe mạnh là gì?
days.titleEn: What is the one thing you do to stay healthy?

items.title: Nghỉ ngơi thật kỹ để kết thúc một ngày
chunks: so finding ways to relax each day
at least six hours of sleep
and I sleep more during the weekends.
I also listen to classical music,
at the end of the day.
relaxation will most certainly add years to my life.
items.en: I think stress and anxiety are killers, so finding ways to relax each day can be a lifesaver. I try to get at least six hours of sleep every day and I sleep more during the weekends. I also listen to classical music, meditate or get massage therapy in order to relax at the end of the day. I think relaxation will most certainly add years to my life.

items.title: Uống nhiều nước
chunks: because our body is composed of nearly 70% water.
I drink at least eight cups of water
and when I need some flavor,
items.en: I think that water is essential for maintaining health and prolonging life because our body is composed of nearly 70% water. Therefore, I try to stay hydrated. I drink at least eight cups of water per day and I drink even more when I exercise. Drinking cold water makes me feel refreshed and when I need some flavor, I drink vitamin water. It tastes really good.

items.title: Luôn ăn sáng đầy đủ
chunks: because I didn’t feel like eating
people who eat an early-morning meal
are less likely to become obese
I started to eat a healthy breakfast
It is a great way to start the day.
items.en: I used to skip breakfast because I didn’t feel like eating in the morning. However, someone told me that people who eat an early-morning meal are less likely to become obese and get diabetes compared to those who don’t. I started to eat a healthy breakfast a few years ago and now I feel better both mentally and physically. It is a great way to start the day.

days.title: Những tình huống mâu thuẫn thỉnh thoảng gặp trong cuộc sống là gì?
days.titleEn: We experience contradiction in our lives from time to time. Can you tell me more about this?

items.title: Chị tôi ăn kiêng 10 năm mà vẫn ăn đêm
chunks: My sister has been on a diet
that she always says she is on a diet
if I wanted to share a bucket of fried chicken
I don’t think she is on a diet.
she has never been on a diet.
items.en: My sister has been on a diet for more than 10 years. The funny thing is that she always says she is on a diet but she rarely exercises. She also enjoys late-night snacks. Last night, she asked me if I wanted to share a bucket of fried chicken with her. It was 10 p.m. so I said no. She ordered it anyway and finished it by herself. I don’t think she is on a diet. I mean, she has never been on a diet.

items.title: Phụ nữ khác gợi cảm thì OK, người yêu tôi thì không!
chunks: there are so many sexy pop stars
and they have a lot of male fans.
those pop stars have a major fashion influence on girls
and many girls try to wear the same clothes
that those guys love to see a sexy outfit
when their girlfriend wears the same thing.
why they can’t let their girlfriend wear sexy clothes
while they are still checking out
the girls in a sexy outfit on the street.
items.en: Today, there are so many sexy pop stars and they have a lot of male fans. Many guys love to see the revealing outfits they wear for their performances. The thing is those pop stars have a major fashion influence on girls and many girls try to wear the same clothes as they wear. The ironic thing is that those guys love to see a sexy outfit on the pop stars but they don’t like it when their girlfriend wears the same thing. I don’t understand why they can’t let their girlfriend wear sexy clothes while they are still checking out the girls in a sexy outfit on the street.

items.title: Học thêm mà thành tích vẫn thấp
chunks: there are a lot of private educational institutes
Almost every student from elementary school to high school
goes to a private institute after school
though South Korea is an OECD member,
it has one of the lowest academic achievement rates
items.en: Different from any other countries, there are a lot of private educational institutes in South Korea. Almost every student from elementary school to high school goes to a private institute after school and studies until late. However, the strange thing is though South Korea is an OECD member, it has one of the lowest academic achievement rates in the world. It is very ironic.

days.title: Bạn làm gì để ngủ ngon hơn?
days.titleEn: What do you do to get better sleep?

items.title: Không uống rượu trước khi ngủ
chunks: that alcohol could help me drop off.
So when I couldn’t fall asleep,
I would have a few glasses of wine
that alcohol may help you doze off,
but it also causes you to wake up
you will be continually tossing and turning.
that alcohol does not help at all
items.en: I used to think that alcohol could help me drop off. So when I couldn’t fall asleep, I would have a few glasses of wine or some beer. However, I heard that alcohol may help you doze off, but it also causes you to wake up every 90 minutes. Therefore, throughout the night, you will be continually tossing and turning. I realized that alcohol does not help at all and I even avoid drinking three hours before bed.

items.title: Tắt đèn tối và tắt mọi thiết bị điện tử
chunks: The whole environment of my bedroom
When my bedroom is not cool enough,
I also turn off everything around me
items.en: The whole environment of my bedroom is very important for me to sleep well. When my bedroom is not cool enough, I can’t fall asleep. My ideal sleeping temperature is 26 degrees Celsius. Also, bright light wakes me up so I dim the lights before I go to bed. When I dim the lights, I also turn off everything around me including my TV, iPad, and even my cell phone.

items.title: Đi ngủ và dậy đúng giờ đã định
chunks: going to bed at the same time
at the same time every morning
because I went out for a drink
When I go to bed late,
items.en: I think going to bed at the same time every night and waking up at the same time every morning is very important for having a good sleep. When I was in college, I couldn’t go to bed at the same time every night because I went out for a drink every single night. When I go to bed late, it makes it harder to get to sleep at the usual hour the following night.

days.title: Khả năng tự chủ của bạn thế nào?
days.titleEn: How is your self-control? Tell me about it.

items.title: Đã kiềm chế hành động xấu để được khen
chunks: My family didn’t believe in spanking
I got praised for my good behavior
I tried not to do anything bad
only because I wanted to get praised.
items.en: I was a well-disciplined child when I was young. My family didn’t believe in spanking and they knew there were many alternatives to encourage children to behave. They tried to praise me as much as possible. I got praised for my good behavior and I grew up confident. I tried not to do anything bad only because I wanted to get praised.

items.title: Mất tự chủ khi đói bụng
chunks: eating less is the most challenging thing
I had to quit late-night snacks
and it was the hardest thing ever.
at least three cups of instant noodles,
and I started to hate myself.
Eating less is the most difficult thing.
items.en: I think eating less is the most challenging thing for me. I love eating late-night snacks but I had gained 10 pounds in just a month. I had to quit late-night snacks and it was the hardest thing ever. When I am hungry, I lose control and just start binge eating. After eating at least three cups of instant noodles, I realized that I ate a lot and I started to hate myself. Eating less is the most difficult thing.

items.title: Mất tự chủ khi say rượu
chunks: after drinking a bottle of soju.
That is where I need to stop drinking.
and start to drink more and more.
When I drink more than a bottle of soju,
I black out and get a bad hangover
I always regret it in the morning
but it is not easy to control myself
items.en: I get drunk after drinking a bottle of soju. That is where I need to stop drinking. However, when I get drunk, I lose control and start to drink more and more. When I drink more than a bottle of soju, I black out and get a bad hangover the next morning. I always regret it in the morning but it is not easy to control myself when I am drunk.
